sections.label: A prayer or charm for the defeat and destruction of enemies in battle
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 1

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नः शत्रून् प्रत्येतु विद्वान् प्रतिदहन्नभिशस्तिमरातिम्।
स सेनां मोहयतु परेषां निर्हस्तांश्च कृणवज्जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: agnirnaḥ śatrūn pratyetu vidvān pratidahannabhiśastimarātim sa senāṃ mohayatu pareṣāṃ nirhastāṃśca kṛṇavajjātavedāḥ
verses.en: Let the wise Agni go against our foemen, burning against ill-will and imprecation. Let him bewilder our opponents' army. Let Jatavedas smite and make them handless.

verses.sa:
यूयमुग्रा मरुत ईदृशे स्थाभि प्रेत मृणत सहध्वम्।
अमीमृणन् वसवो नाथिता इमे अग्निर्ह्येऽषां दूतः प्रत्येतु विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: yūyamugrā maruta īdṛśe sthābhi preta mṛṇata sahadhvam amīmṛṇan vasavo nāthitā ime agnirhye'ṣāṃ dūtaḥ pratyetu vidvān
verses.en: Mighty are ye for such a deed, O Maruts. Go forward, overcome them and destroy them. The Vasus slew, and these were left imploring. Wise Agni as our messenger assail them!

verses.sa:
अमित्रसेनां मघवन्नस्मान् छत्रूयतीमभि।
युवं तानिन्द्र वृत्रहन्नग्निश्च दहतं प्रति॥
verses.tr: amitrasenāṃ maghavannasmān chatrūyatīmabhi yuvaṃ tānindra vṛtrahannagniśca dahataṃ prati
verses.en: O Maghavan, O Indra, thou who slayest fiends, and, Agni, thou, Burn, both of you, against these men, the foeman's host that threatens us.

verses.sa:
प्रसूत इन्द्र प्रवता हरिभ्यां प्र ते वज्रः प्रमृणन्नेतु शत्रून्।
जहि प्रतीचो अनूचः पराचो विष्वक् सत्यं कृणुहि चित्तमेषाम्॥
verses.tr: prasūta indra pravatā haribhyāṃ pra te vajraḥ pramṛṇannetu śatrūn jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viṣvak satyaṃ kṛṇuhi cittameṣām
verses.en: Shot down the slope, with thy two tawny coursers, forth go thy bolt, destroying foes, O Indra! Slay those who fly, slay those who stand and follow. On every side fulfil these men's intention.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सेनां मोहयामित्राणाम्।
अग्नेर्वातस्य ध्राज्या तान् विषूचो वि नाशय॥
verses.tr: indra senāṃ mohayāmitrāṇām agnervātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya
verses.en: Indra, bewilder thou the foemen's army. With Agni's, Vata's furious rush drive them away to every side.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सेनां मोहयतु मरुतो घ्नन्त्वोजसा ।
चक्षूंस्यग्निरा दत्तां पुनरेतु पराजिता॥
verses.tr: indraḥ senāṃ mohayatu maruto ghnantvojasā cakṣūṃsyagnirā dattāṃ punaretu parājitā
verses.en: Let Indra daze their army. Let the Maruts slay it with their might. Let Agni take their eyes away, and let the conquered host retreat.

sections.label: A rifaccimento or recension of Hymn 1
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 2

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नो दूतः प्रत्येतु विद्वान् प्रतिदहन्नभिशस्तिमरातिम्।
स चित्तानि मोहयतु परेषां निर्हस्तांश्च कृणवज्जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: agnirno dūtaḥ pratyetu vidvān pratidahannabhiśastimarātim sa cittāni mohayatu pareṣāṃ nirhastāṃśca kṛṇavajjātavedāḥ
verses.en: May Agni, he who knows, our envoy, meet them, burning against ill-will and imprecation. May he bewilder our opponents' senses. May Jatavedas smite and make them handless.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निरमूमुहद् यानि चित्तानि वो हृदि।
वि वो धमत्वोकसः प्र वो धमतु सर्वतः॥
verses.tr: ayamagniramūmuhad yāni cittāni vo hṛdi vi vo dhamatvokasaḥ pra vo dhamatu sarvataḥ
verses.en: This Agni hath bewildered all the senses that were in your hearts: Now let him blast you from your home, blast you away from every side.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र चित्तानि मोहयन्नर्वाङाकूत्या चर ।
अग्नेर्वातस्य ध्राज्या तान् विषूचो वि नाशय॥
verses.tr: indra cittāni mohayannarvāṅākūtyā cara agnervātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya
verses.en: Dazing their senses, Indra, come hitherward with the wish and will. With Agni's, Vata's furious rush drive them to every side away.

verses.sa:
व्याऽकूतय एषामिताथो चित्तानि मुह्यत ।
अथो यदद्यैषां हृदि तदेषां परि निर्जहि॥
verses.tr: vyā'kūtaya eṣāmitātho cittāni muhyata atho yadadyaiṣāṃ hṛdi tadeṣāṃ pari nirjahi
verses.en: Vanish, ye hopes and plans of theirs, be ye confounded, all their thoughts! Whatever wish is in their heart, do thou expel it utterly.

verses.sa:
अमीषां चित्तानि प्रतिमोहयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि ।
अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैर्ग्राह्यामित्रांस्तमसा विध्य शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: amīṣāṃ cittāni pratimohayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairgrāhyāmitrāṃstamasā vidhya śatrūn
verses.en: B -!l f j the senses of our foemen, seize on their bodies and depart, O Apva! Go meet them, flame within their hearts and burn them.. Smite thou the foes with darkness and amazement.

verses.sa:
असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामस्मानैत्यभ्योजसा स्पर्धमाना ।
तां विध्यत तमसापव्रतेन यथैषामन्यो अन्यं न जानात्॥
verses.tr: asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣāmasmānaityabhyojasā spardhamānā tāṃ vidhyata tamasāpavratena yathaiṣāmanyo anyaṃ na jānāt
verses.en: That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against us with its might, contending Meet ye and strike it with unwelcome darkness so that not one of them may know another.

sections.label: A charm for the restoration of an expelled King
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 3

verses.sa:
अचिक्रदत् स्वपा इह भुवदग्ने व्यऽचस्व रोदसी उरूची।
युञ्जन्तु त्वा मरुतो विश्ववेदस आमुं नय नमसा रातहव्यम्॥
verses.tr: acikradat svapā iha bhuvadagne vya'casva rodasī urūcī yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa āmuṃ naya namasā rātahavyam
verses.en: Loudly he roared. Here let him labour deftly. Spread, Agni, over spacious earth and heaven. Let Maruts who possess all treasures yoke thee. Bring him who reverently paid oblations.

verses.sa:
दूरे चित् सन्तमरुषास इन्द्रमा च्यावयन्तु सख्याय विप्रम्।
यद् गायत्रीं बृहतीमर्कमस्मै सौत्रामण्या दधृषन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: dūre cit santamaruṣāsa indramā cyāvayantu sakhyāya vipram yad gāyatrīṃ bṛhatīmarkamasmai sautrāmaṇyā dadhṛṣanta devāḥ
verses.en: Though he be far away, let the red horses bring Indra, bring the sage to us and friendship, Since with Sautramani Gods for him o'erpower Gayatri, Brihati, and hymn of praises.

verses.sa:
अद्भ्यस्त्वा राजा वरुणो ह्वयतु सोमस्त्वा ह्वयतु पर्वतेभ्यः ।
इन्द्रस्त्वा ह्वयतु विड्भ्य आभ्यः श्येनो भूत्वा विश आ पतेमाः॥
verses.tr: adbhyastvā rājā varuṇo hvayatu somastvā hvayatu parvatebhyaḥ indrastvā hvayatu viḍbhya ābhyaḥ śyeno bhūtvā viśa ā patemāḥ
verses.en: King Varuna call thee hither from the waters! From hills and mountains Soma call thee hither! Let Indra call thee hither to these people. Fly hither to these people as a falcon.

verses.sa:
श्येनो हव्यं नयत्वा परस्मादन्यक्षेत्रेअपरुद्धं चरन्तम्।
अश्विना पन्थां कृणुतां सुगं त इमं सजाता अभिसंविशध्वम्॥
verses.tr: śyeno havyaṃ nayatvā parasmādanyakṣetreaparuddhaṃ carantam aśvinā panthāṃ kṛṇutāṃ sugaṃ ta imaṃ sajātā abhisaṃviśadhvam
verses.en: May the hawk bring the man who must be summoned, from far away, in alien land, an exile. May both the Asvins make thy pathway easy. Come, and unite yourselves with him, ye kinsmen.

verses.sa:
ह्वयन्तु त्वा प्रतिजनाः प्रति मित्रा अवृषत ।
इन्द्राग्नी विश्वे देवास्ते विशि क्षेममदीधरन्॥
verses.tr: hvayantu tvā pratijanāḥ prati mitrā avṛṣata indrāgnī viśve devāste viśi kṣemamadīdharan
verses.en: Let thine opponents call thee back. Thy friends have chosen thee again. Indra and Agni, all the Gods have kept thy home amid the tribe.

verses.sa:
यस्ते हवं विवदत् सजातो यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अपाञ्चमिन्द्र तं कृत्वाथेममिहाव गमय॥
verses.tr: yaste havaṃ vivadat sajāto yaśca niṣṭyaḥ apāñcamindra taṃ kṛtvāthemamihāva gamaya
verses.en: He who disputes our calling thee, be he a stranger or akin, Drive him, O Indra, far away, and do thou bring this man to us.

sections.label: A benediction at the election of a King
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 4

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गन् राष्ट्रं सह वर्चसोदिहि प्राङ्वि विशां पतिरेकराट् त्वं वि राज ।
सर्वास्त्वा राजन् प्रदिशो ह्वयन्तूपसद्यो नमस्योऽ भवेह॥
verses.tr: ā tvā gan rāṣṭraṃ saha varcasodihi prāṅvi viśāṃ patirekarāṭ tvaṃ vi rāja sarvāstvā rājan pradiśo hvayantūpasadyo namasyo' bhaveha
verses.en: To thee hath come the kingship with its splendour: On! shine as lord, sole "in of the people. King! let all regions of the heavens invite thee. Here let men wait on thee and bow before thee.

verses.sa:
त्वां विशो वृणतां राज्याऽय त्वामिमाः प्रदिशः पञ्च देवीः ।
वर्ष्मन् राष्ट्रस्य ककुदि श्रयस्व ततो न उग्रो वि भजा वसूनि॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ viśo vṛṇatāṃ rājyā'ya tvāmimāḥ pradiśaḥ pañca devīḥ varṣman rāṣṭrasya kakudi śrayasva tato na ugro vi bhajā vasūni
verses.en: The tribesmen shall elect thee for the kingship, these five celestial regions shall elect thee. Rest on the height and top of kingly power: thence as a mighty man award us treasures.

verses.sa:
अच्छ त्वा यन्तु हविनः सजाता अग्निर्दूतो अजिरः सं चरातै ।
जायाः पुत्राः सुमनसो भवन्तु बहुं बलिं प्रति पश्यासा उग्रः॥
verses.tr: accha tvā yantu havinaḥ sajātā agnirdūto ajiraḥ saṃ carātai jāyāḥ putrāḥ sumanaso bhavantu bahuṃ baliṃ prati paśyāsā ugraḥ
verses.en: Kinsmen, inviting thee, shall go to meet thee, with thee go Agni as an active herald. Let women and their sons be friendly-minded. Thou, mighty one, shalt see abundant tribute.

verses.sa:
अश्विना त्वाग्रे मित्रावरुणोभा विश्वे देवा मरुतस्त्वा ह्वयन्तु ।
अधा मनो वसुदेयाय कृणुष्व ततो न उग्रो वि भजा वसूनि॥
verses.tr: aśvinā tvāgre mitrāvaruṇobhā viśve devā marutastvā hvayantu adhā mano vasudeyāya kṛṇuṣva tato na ugro vi bhajā vasūni
verses.en: First shall the Asvins, Varuna and Mitra, the Universal Gods, and Maruts call thee. Then turn thy mind to giving gifts of treasure, thence, mighty one, distribute wealth among us.

verses.sa:
आ प्र द्रव परमस्याः परावतः शिवे ते द्यावापृथिवी उभे स्ताम्।
तदयं राजा वरुणस्तथाह स त्वायमह्वत् स उपेदमेहि॥
verses.tr: ā pra drava paramasyāḥ parāvataḥ śive te dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe stām tadayaṃ rājā varuṇastathāha sa tvāyamahvat sa upedamehi
verses.en: Speed to us hither from the farthest distance. Propitious unto thee be Earth and Heaven. Even so hath Varuna this King asserted, he who himself hath called thee: come thou hither.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेन्द्र मनुष्याः३ परेहि सं ह्यज्ञास्था वरुणैः संविदानः ।
स त्वायमह्वत् स्वे सधस्थे स देवान् यक्षत् स उ कल्पयाद् विशः॥
verses.tr: indrendra manuṣyāḥ3 parehi saṃ hyajñāsthā varuṇaiḥ saṃvidānaḥ sa tvāyamahvat sve sadhasthe sa devān yakṣat sa u kalpayād viśaḥ
verses.en: Pass to the tribes of men O Indra, Indra. Thou with the Varunas hast been found accordant. To his own place this one hath called thee, saying, Let him adore the Gods and guide the clansmen.

verses.sa:
पथ्याऽ रेवतीर्बहुधा विरूपाः सर्वाः संगत्य वरीयस्ते अक्रन्।
तास्त्वा सर्वाः संविदाना ह्वयन्तु दशमीमुग्रः सुमना वशेह॥
verses.tr: pathyā' revatīrbahudhā virūpāḥ sarvāḥ saṃgatya varīyaste akran tāstvā sarvāḥ saṃvidānā hvayantu daśamīmugraḥ sumanā vaśeha
verses.en: The Bounteous Paths in sundry forms and places, all in accord, have given thee room and comfort. Let all of these in concert call thee hither. Live thy tenth decade here, a strong kind ruler.

sections.label: A King's address to an amulet which is to strengthen his authority
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 5

verses.sa:
आयमगन् पर्णमणिर्बली बलेन प्रमृणन्त्सपत्नान्।
ओजो देवानां पय ओषधीनां वर्चसा मा जिन्वत्वप्रयावन्॥
verses.tr: āyamagan parṇamaṇirbalī balena pramṛṇantsapatnān ojo devānāṃ paya oṣadhīnāṃ varcasā mā jinvatvaprayāvan
verses.en: This Parna- Amulet hath come, strong and destroying with its strength my rivals. The power of the Gods, the plants' sweet essence, may it incite me ceaselessly with vigour.

verses.sa:
मयि क्षत्रं पर्णमणे मयि धारयताद् रयिम्।
अहं राष्ट्रस्याभीवर्गे निजो भूयासमुत्तमः॥
verses.tr: mayi kṣatraṃ parṇamaṇe mayi dhārayatād rayim ahaṃ rāṣṭrasyābhīvarge nijo bhūyāsamuttamaḥ
verses.en: O Parna-amulet, in me set firmly might and opulence. Within the compass of my rule may I be rooted and supreme.

verses.sa:
यं निदधुर्वनस्पतौ गुह्यं देवाः प्रियं मणिम्।
तमस्मभ्यं सहायुषा देवा ददतु भर्तवे॥
verses.tr: yaṃ nidadhurvanaspatau guhyaṃ devāḥ priyaṃ maṇim tamasmabhyaṃ sahāyuṣā devā dadatu bhartave
verses.en: That dear mysterious Amulet which Gods have set within the tree, May the Gods grant to me to wear together with extended life.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य पर्णः सह उग्रमागन्निन्द्रेण दत्तो वरुणेन शिष्टः ।
तं प्रियासं बहु रोचमानो दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: somasya parṇaḥ saha ugramāgannindreṇa datto varuṇena śiṣṭaḥ taṃ priyāsaṃ bahu rocamāno dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
verses.en: As Indra's gift, by Varuna instructed, Parna hath come, the mighty strength of Soma: This would I, brightly shining, love and cherish for long life lasting through a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
आ मारुक्षत् पर्णमणिर्मह्या अरिष्टतातये ।
यथाहमुत्तरोऽसान्यर्यम्ण उत संविदः॥
verses.tr: ā mārukṣat parṇamaṇirmahyā ariṣṭatātaye yathāhamuttaro'sānyaryamṇa uta saṃvidaḥ
verses.en: The Parna-charm hath come to me for great security from ill, That I may be exalted, yea, above the wealth of Aryaman.

verses.sa:
ये धीवानो रथकाराः कर्मारा ये मनीषिणः ।
उपस्तीन् पर्ण मह्यं त्वं सर्वान् कृण्वभितो जनान्॥
verses.tr: ye dhīvāno rathakārāḥ karmārā ye manīṣiṇaḥ upastīn parṇa mahyaṃ tvaṃ sarvān kṛṇvabhito janān
verses.en: Sagacious builders of the car, clever and skilful artisans,—Make all the men on every side, Parna, obedient to my will.

verses.sa:
ये राजानो राजकृतः सूता ग्रामण्यऽश्च ये।
उपस्तीन् पर्ण मह्यं त्वं सर्वान् कृण्वभितो जनान्॥
verses.tr: ye rājāno rājakṛtaḥ sūtā grāmaṇya'śca ye upastīn parṇa mahyaṃ tvaṃ sarvān kṛṇvabhito janān
verses.en: The kings and makers of the kings, troop-leaders, masters of the horse,—Make all the men on every side, Parna, obedient to my will.

verses.sa:
पर्णोऽसि तनूपानः सयोनिर्वीरो वीरेण मया ।
संवत्सरस्य तेजसा तेन बध्नामि त्वा मणे॥
verses.tr: parṇo'si tanūpānaḥ sayonirvīro vīreṇa mayā saṃvatsarasya tejasā tena badhnāmi tvā maṇe
verses.en: Thou, Parna, art my body's guard, man kin by birth to me a man. With splendour of the circling year I bind thee on me, Amulet!

sections.label: Address to an amulet which is to secure the defeat of the wearer's
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 6

verses.sa:
पुमान् पुंसः परिजातोऽश्वत्थः खदिरादधि ।
स हन्तु शत्रून् मामकान् यानहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम्॥
verses.tr: pumān puṃsaḥ parijāto'śvatthaḥ khadirādadhi sa hantu śatrūn māmakān yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām
verses.en: Masculine springs from masculine, Asvattha grows from Khadira. May it destroy mine enemies, who hate me and whom I detest.

verses.sa:
तानश्वत्थ निः शृणीहि शत्रून् वैबाधदोधतः ।
इन्द्रेण वृत्रघ्ना मेदी मित्रेण वरुणेन च॥
verses.tr: tānaśvattha niḥ śṛṇīhi śatrūn vaibādhadodhataḥ indreṇa vṛtraghnā medī mitreṇa varuṇena ca
verses.en: Crush down my foes, Asvattha! J Rend, O Burster those who storm and rage, With Indra, slayer of the fiends, with Mitra and with Varuna.

verses.sa:
यथाश्वत्थ निरभनोऽन्तर्महत्यऽर्णवे।
एवा तान्त्सर्वान् निर्भङ्ग्धि यानहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम्॥
verses.tr: yathāśvattha nirabhano'ntarmahatya'rṇave evā tāntsarvān nirbhaṅgdhi yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām
verses.en: As thou hast rent and torn apart, Asvattha! in the mighty sea, So rend asunder all those men who hate me and whom I detest.

verses.sa:
यः सहमानश्चरसि सासहान इव ऋषभः ।
तेनाश्वत्थ त्वया वयं सपत्नान्त्सहिषीमहि॥
verses.tr: yaḥ sahamānaścarasi sāsahāna iva ṛṣabhaḥ tenāśvattha tvayā vayaṃ sapatnāntsahiṣīmahi
verses.en: Thou who like some victorious bull displayest thy surpassing might,—With thee, with thee, Asvattha! we would overcome our enemies.

verses.sa:
सिनात्वेनान् निरृतिर्मृत्योः पाशैरमोक्यैः ।
अश्वत्थ शत्रून् मामकान् यानहं द्वेष्मि ये च माम्॥
verses.tr: sinātvenān nirṛtirmṛtyoḥ pāśairamokyaiḥ aśvattha śatrūn māmakān yānahaṃ dveṣmi ye ca mām
verses.en: Nirriti bind them with the bonds of Death which never may be loosed, Mine enemies, Asvattha! those who hate me and whom I detest.

verses.sa:
यथाश्वत्थ वानस्पत्यानारोहन् कृणुषेऽधरान्।
एवा मे शत्रोर्मूर्धानं विष्वग् भिन्द्धि सहस्व च॥
verses.tr: yathāśvattha vānaspatyānārohan kṛṇuṣe'dharān evā me śatrormūrdhānaṃ viṣvag bhinddhi sahasva ca
verses.en: As thou, Asvattha! mountest on the trees and over-thro west them, So do thou break my foeman's head asunder and o'er power him.

verses.sa:
तेऽधराञ्चः प्र प्लवन्तां छिन्ना नौरिव बन्धनात्।
न वैबाधप्रणुत्तानां पुनरस्ति निवर्तनम्॥
verses.tr: te'dharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā nauriva bandhanāt na vaibādhapraṇuttānāṃ punarasti nivartanam
verses.en: Let them drift downward like a boat torn from the rope that fastened it. There is; no turning back for those whom He who Cleaves hath driven away.

verses.sa:
प्रैणान् नुदे मनसा प्र चित्तेनोत ब्रह्मणा ।
प्रैणान् वृक्षस्य शाखयाश्वत्थस्य नुदामहे॥
verses.tr: praiṇān nude manasā pra cittenota brahmaṇā praiṇān vṛkṣasya śākhayāśvatthasya nudāmahe
verses.en: With mental power I drive them forth, drive them with intellect and charm. We banish and expel them with, the branch of an Asvattha tree.

sections.label: A charm with an amulet of buck horn to drive away hereditary disease
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 7

verses.sa:
हरिणस्य रघुष्यदोऽधि शीर्षणि भेषजम्।
स क्षेत्रियं विषाणया विषूचीनमनीनशत्॥
verses.tr: hariṇasya raghuṣyado'dhi śīrṣaṇi bheṣajam sa kṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayā viṣūcīnamanīnaśat
verses.en: The fleet-foot Roebuck wears upon his head a healing remedy. Innate disease he drives away to all directions with his horn.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा हरिणो वृषा पद्भिश्चतुर्भिरक्रमीत्।
विषाणे वि ष्य गुष्पितं यदस्य क्षेत्रियं हृदि॥
verses.tr: anu tvā hariṇo vṛṣā padbhiścaturbhirakramīt viṣāṇe vi ṣya guṣpitaṃ yadasya kṣetriyaṃ hṛdi
verses.en: With his four feet the vigorous Buck hath bounded in pursuit of thee. Unbind the chronic sickness, Horn! deeply inwoven in the heart.

verses.sa:
अदो यदवरोचते चतुष्पक्षमिव च्छदिः ।
तेना ते सर्वं क्षेत्रियमङ्गेभ्यो नाशयामसि॥
verses.tr: ado yadavarocate catuṣpakṣamiva cchadiḥ tenā te sarvaṃ kṣetriyamaṅgebhyo nāśayāmasi
verses.en: That which shines yonder, like a roof resting on four walls, down on us,—Therewith from out thy body we drive all the chronic malady.

verses.sa:
अमू ये दिवि सुभगे विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
वि क्षेत्रियस्य मुञ्चतामधमं पाशमुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: amū ye divi subhage vicṛtau nāma tārake vi kṣetriyasya muñcatāmadhamaṃ pāśamuttamam
verses.en: May those twin stars, auspicious, named Releasers, up in yonder sky, Loose of the chronic malady the uppermost and lowest bond.

verses.sa:
आप इद् वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः ।
आपो विश्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्त्वा मुञ्चन्तु क्षेत्रियात्॥
verses.tr: āpa id vā u bheṣajīrāpo amīvacātanīḥ āpo viśvasya bheṣajīstāstvā muñcantu kṣetriyāt
verses.en: "Water, indeed, hath power to heal, Water drives malady away. May water—for it healeth all—free thee from permanent disease.

verses.sa:
यदासुतेः क्रियमाणायाः क्षेत्रियं त्वा व्यानशे।
वेदाहं तस्य भेषजं क्षेत्रियं नाशयामि त्वत्॥
verses.tr: yadāsuteḥ kriyamāṇāyāḥ kṣetriyaṃ tvā vyānaśe vedāhaṃ tasya bheṣajaṃ kṣetriyaṃ nāśayāmi tvat
verses.en: Hath some prepared decoction brought inveterate disease on thee, I know the balm that healeth it: we drive the malady away.

verses.sa:
अपवासे नक्षत्राणामपवास उषसामुत।
अपास्मत् सर्वं दुर्भूतमप क्षेत्रियमुच्छतु॥
verses.tr: apavāse nakṣatrāṇāmapavāsa uṣasāmuta apāsmat sarvaṃ durbhūtamapa kṣetriyamucchatu
verses.en: What time the starlight disappears, what time the gleams of Dawn depart, May evil fortune pass from us, the chronic sickness disappear.

sections.label: A charm to secure the submission, loyalty and fidelity of kinsmen
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 8

verses.sa:
आ यातु मित्र ऋतुभिः कल्पमानः संवेशयन् पृथिवीमुस्रियाभिः ।
अथास्मभ्यं वरुणो वायुरग्निर्बृहद् राष्ट्रं संवेश्यंऽ दधातु॥
verses.tr: ā yātu mitra ṛtubhiḥ kalpamānaḥ saṃveśayan pṛthivīmusriyābhiḥ athāsmabhyaṃ varuṇo vāyuragnirbṛhad rāṣṭraṃ saṃveśyaṃ' dadhātu
verses.en: Let Mitra come, arranging, with the Seasons, lulling the Earth to rest with gleams of splendour. And so let Agni, Varuna, and Vayu make our dominion tranquil and exalted. i

verses.sa:
धाता रातिः सवितेदं जुषन्तामिन्द्रस्त्वष्टा प्रति हर्यन्तु मे वचः ।
हुवे देवीमदितिं शूरपुत्रां सजातानां मध्यमेष्ठा यथासानि॥
verses.tr: dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāmindrastvaṣṭā prati haryantu me vacaḥ huve devīmaditiṃ śūraputrāṃ sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhā yathāsāni
verses.en: May Indra, Tvashtar hear my word with favour, may Dhatar, Rati, Savitar accept it. I call the Goddess Aditi, heroes' mother, that I may be the centre of my kinsmen.

verses.sa:
हुवे सोमं सवितारं नमोभिर्विश्वानादित्याँ अहमुत्तरत्वे।
अयमग्निर्दीदायद् दीर्घमेव सजातैरिद्धोऽप्रतिब्रुवद्भिः॥
verses.tr: huve somaṃ savitāraṃ namobhirviśvānādityāṃ ahamuttaratve ayamagnirdīdāyad dīrghameva sajātairiddho'pratibruvadbhiḥ
verses.en: Soma I call, and Savitar with homage, and all the Adityas in the time of contest. Long may this fire send forth its splendour, lighted by kinsmen uttering no word against me.

verses.sa:
इहेदसाथ न परो गमाथेर्यो गोपाः पुष्टपतिर्व आजत्।
अस्मै कामायोप कामिनीर्विश्वे वो देवा उपसंयन्तु॥
verses.tr: ihedasātha na paro gamātheryo gopāḥ puṣṭapatirva ājat asmai kāmāyopa kāminīrviśve vo devā upasaṃyantu
verses.en: Here, verily, may you stay: go ye no farther. The strong Herd, Lord of Increase, drive you hither! To please this man may all the Gods together come unto you and be as dames who love him.

verses.sa:
सं वो मनांसि सं व्रता समाकूतीर्नमामसि ।
अमी ये विव्रता स्थन तान् वः सं नमयामसि॥
verses.tr: saṃ vo manāṃsi saṃ vratā samākūtīrnamāmasi amī ye vivratā sthana tān vaḥ saṃ namayāmasi
verses.en: We bend together all your minds, your vows and purposes we bend. We bend together you who stand apart with hopes opposed to ours.

verses.sa:
अहं गृभ्णामि मनसा मनांसि मम चित्तमनु चित्तेभिरेत ।
मम वशेषु हृदयानि वः कृणोमि मम यातमनुवर्त्मान एत॥
verses.tr: ahaṃ gṛbhṇāmi manasā manāṃsi mama cittamanu cittebhireta mama vaśeṣu hṛdayāni vaḥ kṛṇomi mama yātamanuvartmāna eta
verses.en: I with my spirit seize and hold your spirits. Follow with thought and wish my thoughts and wishes. I make your hearts the thralls of my dominion: on me attendant come the way I guide you.

sections.label: A charm against rheumatism (vishkandha)
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 9

verses.sa:
कर्शफस्य विशफस्य द्यौः पिता पृथिवी माता।
यथाभिचक्र देवास्तथाप कृणुता पुनः॥
verses.tr: karśaphasya viśaphasya dyauḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā yathābhicakra devāstathāpa kṛṇutā punaḥ
verses.en: Heaven is the sire, the mother Earth, of Karsapha and Visapha. As ye have brought them hither, Gods! so do ye move them hence away.

verses.sa:
अश्रेष्माणो अधारयन् तथा तन्मनुना कृतम्।
कृणोमि वध्रि विष्कन्धं मुष्काबर्हो गवामिव॥
verses.tr: aśreṣmāṇo adhārayan tathā tanmanunā kṛtam kṛṇomi vadhri viṣkandhaṃ muṣkābarho gavāmiva
verses.en: The bands hold fast without a knot: this is the way that Manu used. I make Vishkandha impotent as one emasculate bulls.

verses.sa:
पिशङ्गे सूत्रे खृगलं तदा बध्नन्ति वेधसः ।
श्रवस्युं शुष्मं काबवं वध्रिं कृण्वन्तु बन्धुरः॥
verses.tr: piśaṅge sūtre khṛgalaṃ tadā badhnanti vedhasaḥ śravasyuṃ śuṣmaṃ kābavaṃ vadhriṃ kṛṇvantu bandhuraḥ
verses.en: Then to a tawny-coloured string the wise. and skilful bind a brush. Let bandages make impotent the strong and active Kabava.

verses.sa:
येना श्रवस्यवश्चरथ देवा इवासुरमायया ।
शुनां कपिरिव दूषणो बन्धुरा काबवस्य च॥
verses.tr: yenā śravasyavaścaratha devā ivāsuramāyayā śunāṃ kapiriva dūṣaṇo bandhurā kābavasya ca
verses.en: Ye who move active in your strength like Gods with Asuras' magic powers,—Even as the monkey scorns the dogs, Bandages! scorn the Kabava.

verses.sa:
दुष्ट्यै हि त्वा भत्स्यामि दूषयिष्यामि काबवम्।
उदाशवो रथा इव शपथेभिः सरिष्यथ॥
verses.tr: duṣṭyai hi tvā bhatsyāmi dūṣayiṣyāmi kābavam udāśavo rathā iva śapathebhiḥ sariṣyatha
verses.en: Yea, I will chide thee to thy shame, I will disgrace the Kabava. Under our imprecations ye, like rapid cars, shall pass away.

verses.sa:
एकशतं विष्कन्धानि विष्ठिता पृथिवीमनु ।
तेषां त्वामग्रे उज्जहरुर्मणिं विष्कन्धदूषणम्॥
verses.tr: ekaśataṃ viṣkandhāni viṣṭhitā pṛthivīmanu teṣāṃ tvāmagre ujjaharurmaṇiṃ viṣkandhadūṣaṇam
verses.en: One and one hundred over earth are the Vishkandhas spread abroad. Before these have they fetched thee forth, Vishkaridha-j.- "i: - Amulet.

sections.label: A new Year prayer
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 10

verses.sa:
प्रथमा ह व्युऽवास सा धेनुरभवद् यमे।
सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम्॥
verses.tr: prathamā ha vyu'vāsa sā dhenurabhavad yame sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām
verses.en: The First hath dawned. With Yama may it bea cow to pour forth milk. May she be rich in milk and stream for us through many a coming year.

verses.sa:
यां देवाः प्रतिनन्दन्ति रात्रिं धेनुमुपायतीम्।
संवत्सरस्य या पत्नी सा नो अस्तु सुमङ्गली॥
verses.tr: yāṃ devāḥ pratinandanti rātriṃ dhenumupāyatīm saṃvatsarasya yā patnī sā no astu sumaṅgalī
verses.en: May she whom Gods accept with joy, Night who approacheth as a cow, She who is Consort of the Year, bring us abundant happiness.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरस्य प्रतिमां यां त्वा रात्र्युपास्महे ।
सा न आयुष्मतीं प्रजां रायस्पोषेण सं सृज॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsarasya pratimāṃ yāṃ tvā rātryupāsmahe sā na āyuṣmatīṃ prajāṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja
verses.en: Thou whom with reverence we approach, O Night, as model of the Year, Vouchsafe us children long to live, bless us with increase of our wealth.

verses.sa:
इयमेव सा या प्रथमा व्यौच्छदास्वितरासु चरति प्रविष्टा ।
महान्तो अस्यां महिमानो अन्तर्वधूर्जिगाय नवगज्जनित्री॥
verses.tr: iyameva sā yā prathamā vyaucchadāsvitarāsu carati praviṣṭā mahānto asyāṃ mahimāno antarvadhūrjigāya navagajjanitrī
verses.en: This same is she whose light first dawned upon us: she moves established in the midst of others. Great powers and glories are contained within her: a first-born bride, she conquers and bears children.

verses.sa:
वानस्पत्या ग्रावाणो घोषमक्रत हविष्कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम्।
एकाष्टके सुप्रजसः सुवीरा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: vānaspatyā grāvāṇo ghoṣamakrata haviṣkṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam ekāṣṭake suprajasaḥ suvīrā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām
verses.en: Loud was the wooden press-gear's ring and rattle, as it made annual oblation ready. First Ashtaka! may we be lords of riches, with goodly children and good men about us.

verses.sa:
इडायास्पदं घृतवत् सरीसृपं जातवेदः प्रति हव्या गृभाय ।
ये ग्राम्याः पशवो विश्वरूपास्तेषां सप्तानां मयि रन्तिरस्तु॥
verses.tr: iḍāyāspadaṃ ghṛtavat sarīsṛpaṃ jātavedaḥ prati havyā gṛbhāya ye grāmyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpāsteṣāṃ saptānāṃ mayi rantirastu
verses.en: The shrine of flows with oil and fatness: accept, O Jatavedas, our oblations. Tame animals of varied form and colour—may all the seven abide with me contented.

verses.sa:
आ मा पुष्टे च पोषे च रात्रि देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ।
पूर्णा दर्वे परा पत सुपूर्णा पुनरा पत ।
सर्वान् यज्ञान्त्संभुञ्जतीषमूर्जं न आ भर॥
verses.tr: ā mā puṣṭe ca poṣe ca rātri devānāṃ sumatau syāma pūrṇā darve parā pata supūrṇā punarā pata sarvān yajñāntsaṃbhuñjatīṣamūrjaṃ na ā bhara
verses.en: Come thou to nourish me and make me prosper. Night! may the favour of the Gods attend us. Filled full, O Ladle, fly thou forth. Completely filled fly back again. Serving at every sacrifice bring to us food and energy.

verses.sa:
आयमगन्त्संवत्सरः पतिरेकाष्टके तव ।
सा न आयुष्मतीं प्रजां रायस्पोषेण सं सृज॥
verses.tr: āyamagantsaṃvatsaraḥ patirekāṣṭake tava sā na āyuṣmatīṃ prajāṃ rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja
verses.en: This Year hath come to us, thy lord and consort, O Ekashtaka. Vouchsafe us children long to live, bless us with increase of our wealth.

verses.sa:
ऋतून् यज ऋतुपतीनार्तवानुत हायनान्।
समाः संवत्सरान् मासान् भूतस्य पतये यजे॥
verses.tr: ṛtūn yaja ṛtupatīnārtavānuta hāyanān samāḥ saṃvatsarān māsān bhūtasya pataye yaje
verses.en: The Seasons, and the Seasons' Lords I worship, annual parts and groups, Half-years, Years, Months, I offer to the Lord of all existing things.

verses.sa:
ऋतुभ्यष्ट्वार्तवेभ्यो माद्भ्यः संवत्सरेभ्यः ।
धात्रे विधात्रे समृधे भूतस्य पतये यजे॥
verses.tr: ṛtubhyaṣṭvārtavebhyo mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarebhyaḥ dhātre vidhātre samṛdhe bhūtasya pataye yaje
verses.en: I offer to the Seasons, to their several groups, to Months, to Years, Dhatar, Vidhatar, Fortune, to the Lord of all existing things.

verses.sa:
इडया जुह्वतो वयं देवान् घृतवता यजे ।
गृहानलुभ्यतो वयं सं विशेमोप गोमतः॥
verses.tr: iḍayā juhvato vayaṃ devān ghṛtavatā yaje gṛhānalubhyato vayaṃ saṃ viśemopa gomataḥ
verses.en: With fatness and libation we sacrifice and adore the Gods Wealthy in kine may we retire to rest us in our modest homes.

verses.sa:
एकाष्टका तपसा तप्यमाना जजान गर्भं महिमानमिन्द्रम्।
तेन देवा व्यऽसहन्त शत्रून् हन्ता दस्यूनामभवच्छचीपतिः॥
verses.tr: ekāṣṭakā tapasā tapyamānā jajāna garbhaṃ mahimānamindram tena devā vya'sahanta śatrūn hantā dasyūnāmabhavacchacīpatiḥ
verses.en: Ekashtaka, burning with zealous fervour, brought forth her babe the great and glorious Indra. With him the Gods subdued their adversaries: the Lord of Might became the Dasyus' slayer.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रपुत्रे सोमपुत्रे दुहितासि प्रजापतेः ।
कामानस्माकं पूरय प्रति गृह्णाहि नो हविः॥
verses.tr: indraputre somaputre duhitāsi prajāpateḥ kāmānasmākaṃ pūraya prati gṛhṇāhi no haviḥ
verses.en: Indra's and Soma's mother! thou art daughter of Prajapati. Satisfy thou our hearts' desires. Gladly accept our sacrifice.

sections.label: A charm for the recovery of a dangerously sick man
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 11

verses.sa:
मुञ्चामि त्वा हविषा जीवनाय कमज्ञातयक्ष्मादुत राजयक्ष्मात्।
ग्राहिर्जग्राह यद्येतदेनं तस्या इन्द्राग्नी प्र मुमुक्तमेनम्॥
verses.tr: muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya kamajñātayakṣmāduta rājayakṣmāt grāhirjagrāha yadyetadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam
verses.en: For life I set thee free by this oblation both from unmarked decline and from consumption: Or if the grasping demon have possessed him, free him from her, O Indra, thou and Agni!

verses.sa:
यदि क्षितायुर्यदि वा परेतो यदि मृत्योरन्तिकं नीत एव।
तमा हरामि निरृतेरुपस्थादस्पार्शमेनं शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā pareto yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva tamā harāmi nirṛterupasthādaspārśamenaṃ śataśāradāya
verses.en: Be his days ended, be he now departed, be he brought very near to death already, Out of Destruction's lap again I bring him, save him for life to last a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षेण शतवीर्येण शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम्।
इन्द्रो यथैनं शरदो नयात्यति विश्वस्य दुरितस्य पारम्॥
verses.tr: sahasrākṣeṇa śatavīryeṇa śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam indro yathainaṃ śarado nayātyati viśvasya duritasya pāram
verses.en: With sacrifice hundred-eyed and hundred-powered, bringing a hundred lives, have I restored him, That Indra through the autumns may conduct him. safe to the farther shore of all misfortune.

verses.sa:
शतं जीव शरदो वर्धमानः शतं हेमन्तान् छतमु वसन्तान्।
शतं त इन्द्रो अग्निः सविता बृहस्पतिः शतायुषा हविषाहार्षमेनम्॥
verses.tr: śataṃ jīva śarado vardhamānaḥ śataṃ hemantān chatamu vasantān śataṃ ta indro agniḥ savitā bṛhaspatiḥ śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam
verses.en: Live, waxing in thy strength, a hundred autumns, live through a hundred springs, a hundred winters! Indra, Agni, Savitar, Brihaspati give thee a hundred! With hundred-lived oblation have I saved him.

verses.sa:
प्र विशतं प्राणापानावनड्वाहाविव व्रजम्।
व्य१न्ये यन्तु मृत्यवो यानाहुरितरान् छतम्॥
verses.tr: pra viśataṃ prāṇāpānāvanaḍvāhāviva vrajam vya1nye yantu mṛtyavo yānāhuritarān chatam
verses.en: Breath, Respiration, come to him, as two car-oxen to their stall! Let all the other deaths, whereof men count a hundred, pass away.

verses.sa:
इहैव स्तं प्राणापानौ माप गातमितो युवम्।
शरीरमस्याङ्गानि जरसे वहतं पुनः॥
verses.tr: ihaiva staṃ prāṇāpānau māpa gātamito yuvam śarīramasyāṅgāni jarase vahataṃ punaḥ
verses.en: Breath, Respiration, stay ye here. Go ye not hence away from him. Bring, so that he may reach old age, body and members back again.

verses.sa:
जरायै त्वा परि ददामि जरायै नि धुवामि त्वा ।
जरा त्वा भद्रा नेष्ट व्य१न्ये यन्तु मृत्यवो यानाहुरितरान् छतम्॥
verses.tr: jarāyai tvā pari dadāmi jarāyai ni dhuvāmi tvā jarā tvā bhadrā neṣṭa vya1nye yantu mṛtyavo yānāhuritarān chatam
verses.en: I give thee over to old age, make thee the subject of old age. Let kindly old age lead thee on. Let all the other deaths, whereof men count a hundred, pass away!

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा जरिमाहित गामुक्षणमिव रज्ज्वा ।
यस्त्वा मृत्युरभ्यधत्त जायमानं सुपाशया ।
तं ते सत्यस्य हस्ताभ्यामुदमुञ्चद् बृहस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā jarimāhita gāmukṣaṇamiva rajjvā yastvā mṛtyurabhyadhatta jāyamānaṃ supāśayā taṃ te satyasya hastābhyāmudamuñcad bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.en: Old age hath girt thee with its bonds even as they bind a bull with rope. The death that held thee at thy birth bound with a firmly-knotted noose, Therefrom, with both the hands of Truth, Brihaspati hath loosened thee.

sections.label: A benediction on a newly built house
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 12

verses.sa:
इहैव ध्रुवां नि मिनोमि शालां क्षेमे तिष्ठाति घृतमुक्षमाणा ।
तां त्वा शाले सर्ववीराः सुवीरा अरिष्टवीरा उप सं चरेम॥
verses.tr: ihaiva dhruvāṃ ni minomi śālāṃ kṣeme tiṣṭhāti ghṛtamukṣamāṇā tāṃ tvā śāle sarvavīrāḥ suvīrā ariṣṭavīrā upa saṃ carema
verses.en: Here, even here I fix my firm-set dwelling: flowing with fatness may it stand in safety. May we approach thee, House! with all our people, unharmed and goodly men, and dwell within thee.

verses.sa:
इहैव ध्रुवा प्रति तिष्ठ शालेऽश्वावती गोमती सूनृतावती ।
ऊर्जस्वती घृतवती पयस्वत्युच्छ्रयस्व महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: ihaiva dhruvā prati tiṣṭha śāle'śvāvatī gomatī sūnṛtāvatī ūrjasvatī ghṛtavatī payasvatyucchrayasva mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: Even here, O House, stand thou on firm foundation, wealthy in horses, rich in kine and gladness. Wealthy in nourishment, in milk and fatness, rise up for great felicity and fortune.

verses.sa:
धरुण्यऽसि शाले बृहच्छन्दाः पूतिधान्या ।
आ त्वा वत्सो गमेदा कुमार आ धेनवः सायमास्पन्दमानाः॥
verses.tr: dharuṇya'si śāle bṛhacchandāḥ pūtidhānyā ā tvā vatso gamedā kumāra ā dhenavaḥ sāyamāspandamānāḥ
verses.en: A spacious store, O House, art thou, full of clean corn and lofty-roofed. Let the young calf and little boy approach thee, and milch-kine streaming homeward in the evening.

verses.sa:
इमां शालां सविता वायुरिन्द्रो बृहस्पतिर्नि मिनोतु प्रजानन्।
उक्षन्तूद्ना मरुतो घृतेन भगो नो राजा नि कृषिं तनोतु॥
verses.tr: imāṃ śālāṃ savitā vāyurindro bṛhaspatirni minotu prajānan ukṣantūdnā maruto ghṛtena bhago no rājā ni kṛṣiṃ tanotu
verses.en: This House may Savitar and Vayu stablish, Brihaspati who knows the way, and Indra. May the moist Maruts sprinkle ia with fatness, and may King Bhaga make our corn-land fruitful.

verses.sa:
मानस्य पत्नि शरणा स्योना देवी देवेभिर्निमितास्यग्रे ।
तृणं वसाना सुमना असस्त्वमथास्मभ्यं सहवीरं रयिं दाः॥
verses.tr: mānasya patni śaraṇā syonā devī devebhirnimitāsyagre tṛṇaṃ vasānā sumanā asastvamathāsmabhyaṃ sahavīraṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
verses.en: Queen of the Home! thou, sheltering, kindly Goddess, wast stablished by the Gods in the beginning. Clad in thy robe of grass be friendly-minded, and give us wealth with goodly men about us.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन स्थूणामधि रोह वंशोग्रो विराजन्नप वृङ्क्ष्व शत्रून्।
मा ते रिषन्नुपसत्तारो गृहाणां शाले शतं जीवेम शरदः सर्ववीराः॥
verses.tr: ṛtena sthūṇāmadhi roha vaṃśogro virājannapa vṛṅkṣva śatrūn mā te riṣannupasattāro gṛhāṇāṃ śāle śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ sarvavīrāḥ
verses.en: Thou Pole, in ordered fashion mount the pillar. Strong, shining forth afar, keep off our foemen. House! let not those who dwell within thee suffer. Live we, with all our men, a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
एमां कुमारस्तरुण आ वत्सो जगता सह।
एमां परिस्रुतः कुम्भ आ दध्नः कलशैरगुः॥
verses.tr: emāṃ kumārastaruṇa ā vatso jagatā saha emāṃ parisrutaḥ kumbha ā dadhnaḥ kalaśairaguḥ
verses.en: To this the tender boy hath come, to this the calf with all the beasts, To this the crock of foaming drink, hither with jars of curdled milk.

verses.sa:
पूर्णं नारि प्र भर कुम्भमेतं घृतस्य धाराममृतेन संभृताम्।
इमां पातॄनमृतेना समङ्ग्धीष्टापूर्तमभि रक्षात्येनाम्॥
verses.tr: pūrṇaṃ nāri pra bhara kumbhametaṃ ghṛtasya dhārāmamṛtena saṃbhṛtām imāṃ pātṝnamṛtenā samaṅgdhīṣṭāpūrtamabhi rakṣātyenām
verses.en: Bring hitherward, O dame, the well-filled pitcher, the stream of molten butter blent with nectar. Bedew these drinkers with a draught of Amrit. May all our hopes' fulfilment guard this dwelling.

verses.sa:
इमा आपः प्र भराम्ययक्ष्मा यक्ष्मनाशनीः ।
गृहानुप प्र सीदाम्यमृतेन सहाग्निना॥
verses.tr: imā āpaḥ pra bharāmyayakṣmā yakṣmanāśanīḥ gṛhānupa pra sīdāmyamṛtena sahāgninā
verses.en: Water that kills Consumption, free from all Consumption, here I bring. With Agni, the immortal one, I enter and possess the house.

sections.label: A benediction on a newly cut water channel
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 13

verses.sa:
यददः संप्रयतीरहावनदता हते।
तस्मादा नद्यो३ नाम स्थ ता वो नामानि सिन्धवः॥
verses.tr: yadadaḥ saṃprayatīrahāvanadatā hate tasmādā nadyo3 nāma stha tā vo nāmāni sindhavaḥ
verses.en: As Yb when Ahi had been slain, flowed forth together with a roar, So are ye called the Roaring Ones: this, O ye Rivers, is your name.

verses.sa:
यत् प्रेषिता वरुणेनाच्छीभं समवल्गत ।
तदाप्नोदिन्द्रो वो यतीस्तस्मादापो अनु ष्ठन॥
verses.tr: yat preṣitā varuṇenācchībhaṃ samavalgata tadāpnodindro vo yatīstasmādāpo anu ṣṭhana
verses.en: As driven forth by Varuna ye swiftly urged your rolling waves, There Indra reached you as you flowed: hence ye are still the Water-floods.

verses.sa:
अपकामं स्यन्दमाना अवीवरत वो हि कम्।
इन्द्रो वः शक्तिभिर्देवीस्तस्माद् वार्नाम वो हितम्॥
verses.tr: apakāmaṃ syandamānā avīvarata vo hi kam indro vaḥ śaktibhirdevīstasmād vārnāma vo hitam
verses.en: Indra restrained you with his might, Goddesses, as ye glided on Not in accordance with his will: hence have ye got the name of Streams.

verses.sa:
एको वो देवोऽप्यतिष्ठत् स्यन्दमाना यथावशम्।
उदानिषुर्महीरिति तस्मादुदकमुच्यते॥
verses.tr: eko vo devo'pyatiṣṭhat syandamānā yathāvaśam udāniṣurmahīriti tasmādudakamucyate
verses.en: One only God set foot on you flowing according to your will. The mighty ones breathed upward fast: hence Water is the name they bear.

verses.sa:
आपो भद्रा घृतमिदाप आसन्नग्नीषोमौ बिभ्रत्याप इत् ताः।
तीव्रो रसो मधुपृचामरंगम आ मा प्राणेन सह वर्चसा गमेत्॥
verses.tr: āpo bhadrā ghṛtamidāpa āsannagnīṣomau bibhratyāpa it tāḥ tīvro raso madhupṛcāmaraṃgama ā mā prāṇena saha varcasā gamet
verses.en: Water is good, water indeed is fatness. Agni and Soma, truly, both bring water. May the strong rain of those who scatter sweetness come helpful unto me with breath and vigour.

verses.sa:
आदित् पश्याम्युत वा शृणोम्या मा घोषो गच्छति वाङ् मासाम्।
मन्ये भेजानो अमृतस्य तर्हि हिरण्यवर्णा अतृपं यदा वः॥
verses.tr: ādit paśyāmyuta vā śṛṇomyā mā ghoṣo gacchati vāṅ māsām manye bhejāno amṛtasya tarhi hiraṇyavarṇā atṛpaṃ yadā vaḥ
verses.en: Then verily, I see, yea, also hear them: their sound approaches me, their voice comes hither. Even then I think I am enjoying Amrit, what time I drink my fill of you, gold coloured!

verses.sa:
इदं व आपो हृदयमयं वत्स ऋतावरीः ।
इहेत्थमेत शक्वरीर्यत्रेदं वेशयामि वः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ va āpo hṛdayamayaṃ vatsa ṛtāvarīḥ ihetthameta śakvarīryatredaṃ veśayāmi vaḥ
verses.en: Here, O ye Waters, is your heart. Here is your calf, ye holy ones. Flow here, just here, O mighty Streams, whither I now am leading you.

sections.label: A benediction on a cattle pen
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 14

verses.sa:
सं वो गोष्ठेन सुषदा सं रय्या सं सुभूत्या ।
अहर्जातस्य यन्नाम तेना वः सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: saṃ vo goṣṭhena suṣadā saṃ rayyā saṃ subhūtyā aharjātasya yannāma tenā vaḥ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: A Pen wherein to dwell at ease, abundance and prosperity, Whatever is called the birth of day, all this do we bestow on you.

verses.sa:
सं वः सृजत्वर्यमा सं पूषा सं बृहस्पतिः ।
समिन्द्रो यो धनंजयो मयि पुष्यत यद् वसु॥
verses.tr: saṃ vaḥ sṛjatvaryamā saṃ pūṣā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ samindro yo dhanaṃjayo mayi puṣyata yad vasu
verses.en: May Aryaman pour gifts on you, and Pushan, and Brihaspati, And Indra, winner of the prize. Make ye my riches grow with me.

verses.sa:
संजग्माना अबिभ्युषीरस्मिन् गोष्ठे करीषिणीः ।
बिभ्रतीः सोम्यं मध्वनमीवा उपेतन॥
verses.tr: saṃjagmānā abibhyuṣīrasmin goṣṭhe karīṣiṇīḥ bibhratīḥ somyaṃ madhvanamīvā upetana
verses.en: Moving together, free from fear, with plenteous droppings in this pen, Bearing sweet milk like Soma-juice, come hither free from all disease.

verses.sa:
इहैव गाव एतनेहो शकेव पुष्यत ।
इहैवोत प्र जायध्वं मयि संज्ञानमस्तु वः॥
verses.tr: ihaiva gāva etaneho śakeva puṣyata ihaivota pra jāyadhvaṃ mayi saṃjñānamastu vaḥ
verses.en: Come hither, to this place, O Cows: here thrive as though ye were manured. Even here increase and multiply: let us be friendly, you and me.

verses.sa:
शिवो वो गोष्ठो भवतु शारिशाकेव पुष्यत ।
इहैवोत प्र जायध्वं मया वः सं सृजामसि॥
verses.tr: śivo vo goṣṭho bhavatu śāriśākeva puṣyata ihaivota pra jāyadhvaṃ mayā vaḥ saṃ sṛjāmasi
verses.en: Auspicious be this stall to you. Prosper like cultivated rice. Even here increase and multiply. Myself do we bestow on you.

verses.sa:
मया गावो गोपतिना सचध्वमयं वो गोष्ठ इह पोषयिष्णुः ।
रायस्पोषेण बहुला भवन्तीर्जीवा जीवन्तीरुप वः सदेम॥
verses.tr: mayā gāvo gopatinā sacadhvamayaṃ vo goṣṭha iha poṣayiṣṇuḥ rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīrjīvā jīvantīrupa vaḥ sadema
verses.en: Follow me, Cows, as master of the cattle. Here may this Cow-pen make you grow and prosper. Still while we live may we approach you living, ever increasing with the growth of riches.

sections.label: A merchant's prayer to Indra
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 15

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमहं वणिजं चोदयामि स न ऐतु पुरएता नो अस्तु ।
नुदन्नरातिं परिपन्थिनं मृगं स ईशानो धनदा अस्तु मह्यम्॥
verses.tr: indramahaṃ vaṇijaṃ codayāmi sa na aitu puraetā no astu nudannarātiṃ paripanthinaṃ mṛgaṃ sa īśāno dhanadā astu mahyam
verses.en: I Stir and animate the merchant Indra: may he approach and be our guide and leader. Chasing ill-will, wild beast, and highway robber, may he who hath the power give me riches.

verses.sa:
ये पन्थानो बहवो देवयाना अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी संचरन्ति ।
ते मा जुषन्तां पयसा घृतेन यथा क्रीत्वा धनमाहराणि॥
verses.tr: ye panthāno bahavo devayānā antarā dyāvāpṛthivī saṃcaranti te mā juṣantāṃ payasā ghṛtena yathā krītvā dhanamāharāṇi
verses.en: The many paths which Gods are wont to travel, the paths which go between the earth and heaven, May they rejoice with me in milk and fatness that I may make rich profit by my purchase.

verses.sa:
इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।
यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वन्दमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीम्॥
verses.tr: idhmenāgna icchamāno ghṛtena juhomi havyaṃ tarase balāya yāvadīśe brahmaṇā vandamāna imāṃ dhiyaṃ śataseyāya devīm
verses.en: With fuel, Agni! and with butter, longing, mine offering I present for strength and conquest; With prayer, so far as I have strength, adoring—this holy hymn to gain a hundred treasures.

verses.sa:
इमामग्ने शरणिं मीमृषो नो यमध्वानमगाम दूरम्।
शुनं नो अस्तु प्रपणो विक्रयश्च प्रतिपणः फलिनं मा कृणोतु ।
इदं हव्यं संविदानौ जुषेथां शुनं नो अस्तु चरितमुत्थितं च॥
verses.tr: imāmagne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo no yamadhvānamagāma dūram śunaṃ no astu prapaṇo vikrayaśca pratipaṇaḥ phalinaṃ mā kṛṇotu idaṃ havyaṃ saṃvidānau juṣethāṃ śunaṃ no astu caritamutthitaṃ ca
verses.en: Pardon this stubbornness of ours, O Agni, the distant pathway which our feet have trodden. Propitious unto us be sale and barter, may interchange of merchandise enrich me. Accept, ye twain, accordant, this libation! Prosperous be our ventures and incomings.

verses.sa:
येन धनेन प्रपणं चरामि धनेन देवा धनमिच्छमानः ।
तन्मे भूयो भवतु मा कनीयोऽग्ने सातघ्नो देवान् हविषा नि षेध॥
verses.tr: yena dhanena prapaṇaṃ carāmi dhanena devā dhanamicchamānaḥ tanme bhūyo bhavatu mā kanīyo'gne sātaghno devān haviṣā ni ṣedha
verses.en: The wealth wherewith I carry on my traffic, seeking, ye Gods! wealth with the wealth I offer, May this grow more for me, not less; O Agni, through sacrifice chase those who hinder profit!

verses.sa:
येन धनेन प्रपणं चरामि धनेन देवा धनमिच्छमानः ।
तस्मिन् म इन्द्रो रुचिमा दधातु प्रजापतिः सविता सोमो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: yena dhanena prapaṇaṃ carāmi dhanena devā dhanamicchamānaḥ tasmin ma indro rucimā dadhātu prajāpatiḥ savitā somo agniḥ
verses.en: The wealth wherewith I carry on my traffic, seeking, ye Gods! wealth with the wealth I offer, Herein may Indra, Savitar, and Soma, Prajapati, and Agni give me splendour.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वैश्वानर स्तुमः ।
स नः प्रजास्वात्मसु गोषु प्राणेषु जागृहि॥
verses.tr: upa tvā namasā vayaṃ hotarvaiśvānara stumaḥ sa naḥ prajāsvātmasu goṣu prāṇeṣu jāgṛhi
verses.en: With reverence we sing thy praise, O Hotar-priest Vaisvanara. Over our children keep thou watch, over our bodies, kine, and lives.

verses.sa:
विश्वाहा ते सदमिद् भरेमाश्वायेव तिष्ठते जातवेदः ।
रायस्पोषेण समिषा मदन्तो मा ते अग्ने प्रतिवेशा रिषाम॥
verses.tr: viśvāhā te sadamid bharemāśvāyeva tiṣṭhate jātavedaḥ rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madanto mā te agne prativeśā riṣāma
verses.en: Still to thee ever will we bring oblation, as to a stabled horse, O Jatavedas. Joying in food and in the growth of riches may we thy servants, Agni, never suffer.

sections.label: A Rishi's morning prayer
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 16

verses.sa:
प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना ।
प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ havāmahe
verses.en: Agni at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna and Mitra, and the Asvins twain: Bhaga at dawn, Pushan and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, and Rudra we invoke at dawn.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हवामहे वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता।
आध्रश्चिद् यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद् राजा चिद् यं भगं भक्षीत्याह॥
verses.tr: prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ havāmahe vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā ādhraścid yaṃ manyamānasturaścid rājā cid yaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha
verses.en: We all strong Bhaga, conqueror in the morning, the son of Aditi, the great Disposer, Whom each who deems himself poor, strong and mighty a king, addresses thus, Grant thou my portion! j

verses.sa:
भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन्नः ।
भग प्र णो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम॥
verses.tr: bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyamudavā dadannaḥ bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhiraśvairbhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma
verses.en: Bhaga, our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, favour this hymn and give us wealth, O Bhaga. Bhaga, augment our store of kine and horses. Bhaga, may we be rich in men and heroes.

verses.sa:
उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्यामोत प्रपित्व उत मध्ये अह्नाम्।
उतोदितौ मघवन्त्सूर्यस्य वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām utoditau maghavantsūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma
verses.en: So may felicity be ours at present, and when the Sun advances, and at noontide; And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy in the Gods' protecting favour.

verses.sa:
भग एव भगवाँ अस्तु देवस्तेना वयं भगवन्तः स्याम ।
तं त्वा भग सर्व इज्जोहवीमि स नो भग पुरएता भवेह॥
verses.tr: bhaga eva bhagavāṃ astu devastenā vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīmi sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha
verses.en: May Bhaga verily be bliss-bestower, and through him, Gods! may happiness attend us. As such with all my might I call and call thee: as such be thou our leader here, O Bhaga.

verses.sa:
समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय ।
अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं मे रथमिवाश्वा वाजिन आ वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ me rathamivāśvā vājina ā vahantu
verses.en: To this our sacrifice may the Dawns incline them, and come to the pure place like Dadhikravan. As strong steeds draw a chariot may they bring me hitherward Bhaga who discovers treasure.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुछन्तु भद्राः ।
घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamuchantu bhadrāḥ ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May the kind Mornings dawn on us for ever with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings!

sections.label: A farmers song and prayer to speed the plough
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 17

verses.sa: सीरा युञ्जन्ति कवयो युगा वि तन्वते पृथक्। धीरा देवेषु सुम्नयौ॥
verses.tr: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak dhīrā deveṣu sumnayau
verses.en: Wise and devoted to the Gods the skilful men bind plough-ropes fast, And lay the yokes on either side.

verses.sa:
युनक्त सीरा वि युगा तनोत कृते योनौ वपतेह बीजम्।
विराजः श्नुष्टिः सभरा असन्नो नेदीय इत् सृण्यः पक्वमा यवन्॥
verses.tr: yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanota kṛte yonau vapateha bījam virājaḥ śnuṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya it sṛṇyaḥ pakvamā yavan
verses.en: Lay on the yokes and fasten well the traces: formed is the furrow, sow the seed within it. Viraj vouchsafe us hearing fraught with plenty! Let the ripe grain come near and near the sickle.

verses.sa:
लाङ्गलं पवीरवत् सुशीमं सोमसत्सरु ।
उदिद् वपतु गामविं प्रस्थावद् रथवाहनं पीबरीं च प्रफर्व्यऽम्॥
verses.tr: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravat suśīmaṃ somasatsaru udid vapatu gāmaviṃ prasthāvad rathavāhanaṃ pībarīṃ ca prapharvya'm
verses.en: The keen-shared plough that bringeth bliss, furnished with traces and with stilts, Shear out for me a cow, a sheep, a rapid drawer of the car, a blooming woman, plump and strong!

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सीतां नि गृह्णातु तां पूषाभि रक्षतु ।
सा नः पयस्वती दुहामुत्तरामुत्तरां समाम्॥
verses.tr: indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu tāṃ pūṣābhi rakṣatu sā naḥ payasvatī duhāmuttarāmuttarāṃ samām
verses.en: May Indra press the furrow down, may Pushan guard and cherish her. May she, well stored with milk, yield milk for us through each succeeding year.

verses.sa:
शुनं सुफाला वि तुदन्तु भूमिं शुनं कीनाशा अनु यन्तु वाहान्।
शुनासीरा हविषा तोशमाना सुपिप्पला ओषधीः कर्तमस्मै॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ suphālā vi tudantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā anu yantu vāhān śunāsīrā haviṣā tośamānā supippalā oṣadhīḥ kartamasmai
verses.en: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, the ploughers happily follow the oxen. Pleased with our sacrifice, Suna and Slra I make the; plants bring this man abundant produce.

verses.sa:
शुनं वाहाः शुनं नरः शुनं कृषतु लाङ्गलम्।
शुनं वरत्रा बध्यन्तां शुनमष्ट्रामुदिङ्गय॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ vāhāḥ śunaṃ naraḥ śunaṃ kṛṣatu lāṅgalam śunaṃ varatrā badhyantāṃ śunamaṣṭrāmudiṅgaya
verses.en: Happily work our steers and men! May the plough furrow happily. Happily be the traces bound. Happily ply the driving-goad.

verses.sa:
शुनासीरेह स्म मे जुषेथाम्।
यद् दिवि चक्रथुः पयस्तेनेमामुप सिञ्चतम्॥
verses.tr: śunāsīreha sma me juṣethām yad divi cakrathuḥ payastenemāmupa siñcatam
verses.en: Suna and Sira, welcome ye this laud, and with the milk that ye have made in heaven Bedew ye both this earth of ours.

verses.sa:
सीते वन्दामहे त्वार्वाची सुभगे भव ।
यथा नः सुमना असो यथा नः सुफला भुवः॥
verses.tr: sīte vandāmahe tvārvācī subhage bhava yathā naḥ sumanā aso yathā naḥ suphalā bhuvaḥ
verses.en: Auspicious Site, come thou near: we venerate and worship thee That thou mayst bless and prosper us and bring us fruits abundantly.

verses.sa:
घृतेन सीता मधुना समक्ता विश्वैर्देवैरनुमता मरुद्भिः ।
सा नः सीते पयसाभ्याववृत्स्वोर्जस्वती घृतवत् पिन्वमाना॥
verses.tr: ghṛtena sītā madhunā samaktā viśvairdevairanumatā marudbhiḥ sā naḥ sīte payasābhyāvavṛtsvorjasvatī ghṛtavat pinvamānā
verses.en: Loved by the Visvedevas and the Maruts, let Sita be bedewed with oil and honey. Turn thou to us with wealth of milk, O Sita, in vigorous strength and pouring streams of fatness.

sections.label: A jealous wife's incantation against a rival
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 18

verses.sa:
इमां खनाम्योषधिं वीरुधां बलवत्तमाम्।
यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ khanāmyoṣadhiṃ vīrudhāṃ balavattamām yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim
verses.en: From out the earth I dig this Plant, an herb of most effectual power, Wherewith one quells the rival wife and gains the husband for one's self.

verses.sa:
उत्तानपर्णे सुभगे देवजूते सहस्वति ।
सपत्नीं मे परा णुद पतिं मे केवलं कृधि॥
verses.tr: uttānaparṇe subhage devajūte sahasvati sapatnīṃ me parā ṇuda patiṃ me kevalaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Auspicious, with expanded leaves, sent by the Gods, victorious Plant, Drive thou the rival wife away, and make my husband only mine.

verses.sa:
नहि ते नाम जग्राह नो अस्मिन् रमसे पतौ ।
परामेव परावतं सपत्नीं गमयामसि॥
verses.tr: nahi te nāma jagrāha no asmin ramase patau parāmeva parāvataṃ sapatnīṃ gamayāmasi
verses.en: Indeed he hath not named her name: thou with this husband dalliest not. Far into distance most remote we drive the rival wife away.

verses.sa:
उत्तराहमुत्तर उत्तरेदुत्तराभ्यः ।
अधः सपत्नी या ममाधरा साधराभ्यः॥
verses.tr: uttarāhamuttara uttareduttarābhyaḥ adhaḥ sapatnī yā mamādharā sādharābhyaḥ
verses.en: Stronger am I, O stronger one, yea, mightier than the mightier; Beneath me be my rival wife, down, lower than the lowest dames!

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सहमानाथो त्वमसि सासहिः ।
उभे सहस्वती भूत्वा सपत्नीं मे सहावहै॥
verses.tr: ahamasmi sahamānātho tvamasi sāsahiḥ ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvā sapatnīṃ me sahāvahai
verses.en: Iam the conqueror, and thou, thou also art victoriAs victory attends us both we will subdue my fellow-wife.

verses.sa:
अभि तेऽधां सहमानामुप तेऽधां सहीयसीम्।
मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु॥
verses.tr: abhi te'dhāṃ sahamānāmupa te'dhāṃ sahīyasīm māmanu pra te mano vatsaṃ gauriva dhāvatu pathā vāriva dhāvatu
verses.en: I've girt thee with the conquering Plant, beneath thee laid the mightiest one. As a cow hastens to her calf, so let thy spirit speed to me, hasten like water on its way.

sections.label: A glorification of the office of a King's household priest
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 19

verses.sa:
संशितं म इदं ब्रह्म संशितं वीर्य१ बलम्।
संशितं क्षत्रमजरमस्तु जिष्णुर्येषामस्मि पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: saṃśitaṃ ma idaṃ brahma saṃśitaṃ vīrya1 balam saṃśitaṃ kṣatramajaramastu jiṣṇuryeṣāmasmi purohitaḥ
verses.en: Quickened is this my priest rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened be changeless power, whereof I am the conquering President!

verses.sa:
समहमेषां राष्ट्रं स्यामि समोजो वीर्य१ बलम्।
वृश्चामि शत्रूणां बाहूननेन हविषाहम्॥
verses.tr: samahameṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ syāmi samojo vīrya1 balam vṛścāmi śatrūṇāṃ bāhūnanena haviṣāham
verses.en: I quicken these men's princely sway, the might, the manly strength and force; I rend away the foemen's arms with this presented sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नीचैः पद्यन्तामधरे भवन्तु ये नः सूरिं मघवानं पृतन्यान्।
क्षिणामि ब्रह्मणामित्रानुन्नयामि स्वानहम्॥
verses.tr: nīcaiḥ padyantāmadhare bhavantu ye naḥ sūriṃ maghavānaṃ pṛtanyān kṣiṇāmi brahmaṇāmitrānunnayāmi svānaham
verses.en: Down fall the men, low let them lie, who fight against our mighty prince. I ruin foemen with my spell, and raise my friends to high estate.

verses.sa:
तीक्ष्णीयांसः परशोरग्नेस्तीक्ष्णतरा उत।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रात् तीक्ष्णीयांसो येषामस्मि पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: tīkṣṇīyāṃsaḥ paraśoragnestīkṣṇatarā uta indrasya vajrāt tīkṣṇīyāṃso yeṣāmasmi purohitaḥ
verses.en: Keener than is the axe's edge, keener than Agni's self are they, Keener than Indra's bolt are they whose Priest and President am I.

verses.sa:
एषामहमायुधा सं स्याम्येषां राष्ट्रं सुवीरं वर्धयामि ।
एषां क्षत्रमजरमस्तु जिष्ण्वे३षां चित्तं विश्वेऽवन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: eṣāmahamāyudhā saṃ syāmyeṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ suvīraṃ vardhayāmi eṣāṃ kṣatramajaramastu jiṣṇve3ṣāṃ cittaṃ viśve'vantu devāḥ
verses.en: The weapons of these men I whet and sharpen, with valiant heroes I increase their kingdom. Victorious be their power and ever ageless! May all the Gods promote their thoughts and wishes.

verses.sa:
उद्धर्षन्तां मघवन् वाजिनान्युद् वीराणां जयतामेतु घोषः ।
पृथग् घोषा उलुलयः केतुमन्त उदीरताम्।
देवा इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुतो यन्तु सेनया॥
verses.tr: uddharṣantāṃ maghavan vājinānyud vīrāṇāṃ jayatāmetu ghoṣaḥ pṛthag ghoṣā ululayaḥ ketumanta udīratām devā indrajyeṣṭhā maruto yantu senayā
verses.en: Let their fierce powers, O Maghavan, be heightened, and upward go the shout of conquering heroes. Apart and clear, let shout and roar and shriek and lamentation rise! Let the Gods led by Indra, let the Maruts with our army go.

verses.sa:
प्रेता जयता नर उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवः ।
तीक्ष्णेषवोऽबलधन्वनो हतोग्रायुधा अबलानुग्रबाहवः॥
verses.tr: pretā jayatā nara ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavaḥ tīkṣṇeṣavo'baladhanvano hatogrāyudhā abalānugrabāhavaḥ
verses.en: Advance and be victorious, men! Exceeding mighty be your arms! Smite with sharp-pointed arrows those whose bows are weak. With your strong arms and weapons smite the feeble foe.

verses.sa:
अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसंशिते ।
जयामित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व जह्येऽषां वरंवरं मामीषां मोचि कश्चन॥
verses.tr: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite jayāmitrān pra padyasva jahye'ṣāṃ varaṃvaraṃ māmīṣāṃ moci kaścana
verses.en: Loosed from the bowstring fly away, thou Arrow, sharpened by our prayer. Assail the foemen, vanquish them, conquer each bravest man of theirs, and let not one of them escape.

sections.label: A prayer for riches and general prosperity Ill
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 20

verses.sa:
अयं ते योनिरृत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः ।
तं जानन्नग्न आ रोहाधा नो बर्धय रयिम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānannagna ā rohādhā no bardhaya rayim
verses.en: This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shinest forth. Knowing this, Agni, mount on high and cause our riches to increase.

verses.sa:
अग्ने अच्छा वदेह नः प्रत्यङ् नः सुमना भव ।
प्र णो यच्छ विशां पते धनदा असि नस्त्वम्॥
verses.tr: agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ sumanā bhava pra ṇo yaccha viśāṃ pate dhanadā asi nastvam
verses.en: Turn hither, Agni, speak to us, come to us with a friendly mind. Enrich us, Sovran of the Tribes! Thou art the giver of our wealth.

verses.sa:
प्र णो यच्छत्वर्यमा प्र भगः प्र बृहस्पतिः ।
प्र देवीः प्रोत सूनृता रयिं देवी दधातु मे॥
verses.tr: pra ṇo yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ pra devīḥ prota sūnṛtā rayiṃ devī dadhātu me
verses.en: Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Bhaga, and Brihaspati, The Goddesses grant wealth to us, Sunrita, Goddess, give me wealth!

verses.sa:
सोमं राजानमवसेऽग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ।
आदित्यं विष्णुं सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च बृहस्पतिम्॥
verses.tr: somaṃ rājānamavase'gniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe ādityaṃ viṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
verses.en: We call King Soma to our aid, and Agni with our songs and hymn, The Adityas, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय ।
त्वं नो देव दातवे रयिं दानाय चोदय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya tvaṃ no deva dātave rayiṃ dānāya codaya
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, with thy fires strengthen our prayer and sacrifice. Incite thou us, O God, to give, and send us riches to bestow.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रवायू उभाविह सुहवेह हवामहे ।
यथा नः सर्व इज्जनः संगत्यां सुमना असद् दानकामश्च नो भुवत्॥
verses.tr: indravāyū ubhāviha suhaveha havāmahe yathā naḥ sarva ijjanaḥ saṃgatyāṃ sumanā asad dānakāmaśca no bhuvat
verses.en: Both Indra here and Vayu we invoke with an auspicious call, That in assembly all the folk may be benevolent to us, and be inclined to give us gifts.

verses.sa:
अर्यमणं बृहस्पतिमिन्द्रं दानाय चोदय ।
वातं विष्णुं सरस्वतीं सवितारं च वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam
verses.en: Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra, and Brihaspati, Vata, Vishnu, Sarasvati, and the strong courser Savitar.

verses.sa:
वाजस्य नु प्रसवे सं बभूविमेमा च विश्वा भुवनान्यन्तः ।
उतादित्सन्तं दापयतु प्रजानन् रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं नि यछ॥
verses.tr: vājasya nu prasave saṃ babhūvimemā ca viśvā bhuvanānyantaḥ utāditsantaṃ dāpayatu prajānan rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacha
verses.en: Now have we reached the ordering of power, and all these worlds of life are held within: it. Let him who knows urge e'en the churl to bounty. Give wealth to us with all good men about us.

verses.sa:
दुह्रां मे पञ्च प्रदिशो दुह्रामुर्वीर्यथाबलम्।
प्रापेयं सर्वा आकूतीर्मनसा हृदयेन च॥
verses.tr: duhrāṃ me pañca pradiśo duhrāmurvīryathābalam prāpeyaṃ sarvā ākūtīrmanasā hṛdayena ca
verses.en: May heaven's five spacious regions pour their milk for me with all their might. May I obtain each wish and hope formed by my spirit and my heart.

verses.sa:
गोसनिं वाचमुदेयं वर्चसा माभ्युदिहि ।
आ रुन्धां सर्वतो वायुस्त्वष्टा पोषं दधातु मे॥
verses.tr: gosaniṃ vācamudeyaṃ varcasā mābhyudihi ā rundhāṃ sarvato vāyustvaṣṭā poṣaṃ dadhātu me
verses.en: May speech that winneth cows be mine. With splendour mount thou over me. May Vayu hedge me round about. May Pushan make me prosperous.

sections.label: In honour of fire in all shapes
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 21

verses.sa:
ये अग्नयो अप्स्व१न्तर्ये वृत्रे ये पुरुषे ये अश्मसु ।
य आविवेशोषधीर्यो वनस्पतींस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: ye agnayo apsva1ntarye vṛtre ye puruṣe ye aśmasu ya āviveśoṣadhīryo vanaspatīṃstebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: Art Fires that are in water and in Vritra, all those that man and stones contain within them, That which hath entered herbs and trees and bushes—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
यः सोमे अन्तर्यो गोष्वन्तर्य आविष्टो वयःसु यो मृगेषु ।
य आविवेश द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: yaḥ some antaryo goṣvantarya āviṣṭo vayaḥsu yo mṛgeṣu ya āviveśa dvipado yaścatuṣpadastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: That which abides in Soma and in cattle, that which lies deep in birds and sylvan creatures, That which hath entered quadrupeds and bipeds—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्रेण सरथं याति देवो वैश्वानर उत विश्वदाव्यः ।
यं जोहवीमि पृतनासु सासहिं तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: ya indreṇa sarathaṃ yāti devo vaiśvānara uta viśvadāvyaḥ yaṃ johavīmi pṛtanāsu sāsahiṃ tebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: The Fire that rideth by the side of Indra, the God Vaisvanara, yea, all-consuming, Whom, as the victor, I invoke in battles—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
यो देवो विश्वाद् यमु काममाहुर्यं दातारं प्रतिगृह्णन्तमाहुः ।
यो धीरः शक्रः परिभूरदाभ्यस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: yo devo viśvād yamu kāmamāhuryaṃ dātāraṃ pratigṛhṇantamāhuḥ yo dhīraḥ śakraḥ paribhūradābhyastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: The all-devouring God whom men call Kama, he whom they call the Giver and Receiver, Invincible, pervading, wise, and mighty—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा होतारं मनसाभि संविदुस्त्रयोदश भौवनाः पञ्च मानवाः ।
वर्चोधसे यशसे सूनृतावते तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā hotāraṃ manasābhi saṃvidustrayodaśa bhauvanāḥ pañca mānavāḥ varcodhase yaśase sūnṛtāvate tebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: To thee, strength-giver, glorious, rich in pleasant Strains, whom in their minds the thirteen creatures of the world, And the five sons of man regard as Hotar-priest—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे ।
वैश्वानरज्येष्ठेभ्यस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase vaiśvānarajyeṣṭhebhyastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: To him who feeds on ox and cow, sage, bearing Soma on his back, To all Vaisvanara's followers—to these be this oblation paid.

verses.sa:
दिवं पृथिवीमन्वन्तरिक्षं ये विद्युतमनुसंचरन्ति ।
ये दिक्ष्व१न्तर्ये वाते अन्तस्तेभ्यो अग्निभ्यो हुतमस्त्वेतत्॥
verses.tr: divaṃ pṛthivīmanvantarikṣaṃ ye vidyutamanusaṃcaranti ye dikṣva1ntarye vāte antastebhyo agnibhyo hutamastvetat
verses.en: All fiery flames that follow after lightning, flashing o'er earth, through firmament and heaven, All that are in the wind and skyey regions—to all these Fires be this oblation offered.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिं सवितारमिन्द्रं बृहस्पतिं वरुणं मित्रमग्निम्।
विश्वान् देवानङ्गिरसो हवामह इमं क्रव्यादं शमयन्त्वग्निम्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyapāṇiṃ savitāramindraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ varuṇaṃ mitramagnim viśvān devānaṅgiraso havāmaha imaṃ kravyādaṃ śamayantvagnim
verses.en: The golden-handed Savitar and Indra, Brihaspati, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni, The Angirases we call, the Visve Devas: let them appease this Agni, Flesh-devourer.

verses.sa:
शान्तो अग्निः क्रव्याच्छान्तः पुरुषरेषणः ।
अथो यो विश्वदाव्य१स्तं क्रव्यादमशीशमम्॥
verses.tr: śānto agniḥ kravyācchāntaḥ puruṣareṣaṇaḥ atho yo viśvadāvya1staṃ kravyādamaśīśamam
verses.en: Flesh-eating Agni is appeased, appeased is he who hurteth men. Now him who burneth every thing, the Flesh-consumer, have I stilled.

verses.sa:
ये पर्वताः सोमपृष्ठा आप उत्तानशीवरीः ।
वातः पर्जन्य आदग्निस्ते क्रव्यादमशीशमन्॥
verses.tr: ye parvatāḥ somapṛṣṭhā āpa uttānaśīvarīḥ vātaḥ parjanya ādagniste kravyādamaśīśaman
verses.en: The mountains where the Soma grows, the waters lying calm and still, Vata, Parjanya, Agni's self have made the Flesh-consumer rest.

sections.label: The taming and training of an elephant for a King to ride on
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 22

verses.sa:
हस्तिवर्चसं प्रथतां बृहद् यशो अदित्या यत् तन्वः संबभूव ।
तत् सर्वे समदुर्मह्यमेतद् विश्वे देवा अदितिः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: hastivarcasaṃ prathatāṃ bṛhad yaśo adityā yat tanvaḥ saṃbabhūva tat sarve samadurmahyametad viśve devā aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Famed be the Elephant's strength, the lofty glory, which out of Aditi's body took existence! They all have given me this for my possession, even all the Gods and Aditi accordant.

verses.sa: मित्रश्च वरुणश्चेन्द्रो रुद्रश्च चेततु । देवासो विश्वधायसस्ते माञ्जन्तु वर्चसा॥
verses.tr: mitraśca varuṇaścendro rudraśca cetatu devāso viśvadhāyasaste māñjantu varcasā
verses.en: On this have Mitra, Varuna, Indra, and Rudra fixed their thought. May those all-fostering deities anoint and balm me with his strength.

verses.sa:
येन हस्ती वर्चसा संबभूव येन राजा मनुष्येऽष्वप्स्व१न्तः ।
येन देवा देवतामग्र आयन् तेन मामद्य वर्चसाग्ने वर्चस्विनं कृणु॥
verses.tr: yena hastī varcasā saṃbabhūva yena rājā manuṣye'ṣvapsva1ntaḥ yena devā devatāmagra āyan tena māmadya varcasāgne varcasvinaṃ kṛṇu
verses.en: The strength wherewith the Elephant was dowered, that decks a King among the men, in waters, Wherewith the Gods at first attained to godhead, O Agni, even with that strength make thou me vigorous to-day.

verses.sa:
यत् ते वर्चो जातवेदो बृहद् भवत्याहुतेः ।
यावत् सूर्यस्य वर्च आसुरस्य च हस्तिनः ।
तावन्मे अश्विना वर्च आ धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा॥
verses.tr: yat te varco jātavedo bṛhad bhavatyāhuteḥ yāvat sūryasya varca āsurasya ca hastinaḥ tāvanme aśvinā varca ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā
verses.en: The lofty strength which sacrifice brings, Jatavedas! unto thee, What strength the Sun possesses, all strength of the royal Elephant—such strength vouchsafe to me the pair of Asvins lotus-garlanded!

verses.sa:
यावच्चतस्रः प्रदिशश्चक्षुर्यावत् समश्नुते।
तावत् समैत्विन्द्रियं मयि तद्धस्तिवर्चसम्॥
verses.tr: yāvaccatasraḥ pradiśaścakṣuryāvat samaśnute tāvat samaitvindriyaṃ mayi taddhastivarcasam
verses.en: Far as the heavens' four regions spread, far as the eye's most distant ken, So wide, so vast let power be mine, this vigour of the Elephant.

verses.sa:
हस्ती मृगाणां सुषदामतिष्ठावान् बभूव हि।
तस्य भगेन वर्चसाभि षिञ्चामि मामहम्॥
verses.tr: hastī mṛgāṇāṃ suṣadāmatiṣṭhāvān babhūva hi tasya bhagena varcasābhi ṣiñcāmi māmaham
verses.en: Now hath the Elephant become chief of all pleasant beasts to ride. With his high fortune and his strength I grace and consecrate myself.

sections.label: A charm to remove a woman's sterility, and to assure the birth of boys
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 23

verses.sa:
येन वेहद् बभूविथ नाशयामसि तत् त्वत्।
इदं तदन्यत्र त्वदप दूरे नि दध्मसि॥
verses.tr: yena vehad babhūvitha nāśayāmasi tat tvat idaṃ tadanyatra tvadapa dūre ni dadhmasi
verses.en: From thee we banish and expel the cause of thy sterility. This in another place we lay apart from thee and far removed.

verses.sa:
आ ते योनिं गर्भ एतु पुमान् बाण इवेषुधिम्।
आ वीरोऽत्र जायतां पुत्रस्ते दशमास्यः॥
verses.tr: ā te yoniṃ garbha etu pumān bāṇa iveṣudhim ā vīro'tra jāyatāṃ putraste daśamāsyaḥ
verses.en: As arrow to the quiver, so let a male embryo enter thee. Then from thy side be born a babe, a ten-month child, thy hero son.

verses.sa:
पुमांसं पुत्रं जनय तं पुमाननु जायताम्।
भवासि पुत्राणां माता जातानां जनयाश्च यान्॥
verses.tr: pumāṃsaṃ putraṃ janaya taṃ pumānanu jāyatām bhavāsi putrāṇāṃ mātā jātānāṃ janayāśca yān
verses.en: Bring forth a male, bring forth a son. Another male shall follow him. The mother shalt thou be of sons born and hereafter to be born.

verses.sa:
यानि भद्राणि बीजान्यृषभा जनयन्ति च ।
तैस्त्वं पुत्रं विन्दस्व सा प्रसूर्धेनुका भव॥
verses.tr: yāni bhadrāṇi bījānyṛṣabhā janayanti ca taistvaṃ putraṃ vindasva sā prasūrdhenukā bhava
verses.en: With that auspicious general flow wherewith steers propagate their kind, Do thou obtain thyself a son: be thou a fruitful mother-cow.

verses.sa:
कृणोमि ते प्राजापत्यमा योनिं गर्भ एतु ते ।
विन्दस्व त्वं पुत्रं नारि यस्तुभ्यं शमसच्छमु तस्मै त्वं भव॥
verses.tr: kṛṇomi te prājāpatyamā yoniṃ garbha etu te vindasva tvaṃ putraṃ nāri yastubhyaṃ śamasacchamu tasmai tvaṃ bhava
verses.en: I give thee power to bear a child: within thee pass the germ of life! Obtain a son, O woman, who shall be a blessing unto thee. Be thou a blessing unto him.

verses.sa:
यासां द्यौः पिता पृथिवी माता समुद्रो मूलं वीरुधां बभूव ।
तास्त्वा पुत्रविद्याय दैवीः प्रावन्त्वोषधयः॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ dyauḥ pitā pṛthivī mātā samudro mūlaṃ vīrudhāṃ babhūva tāstvā putravidyāya daivīḥ prāvantvoṣadhayaḥ
verses.en: May those celestial herbs whose sire was Heaven, the Earth their mother, and their root the ocean, May those celestial healing Plants assist thee to obtain a son.

sections.label: A song of harvest
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 24

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं वचः ।
अथो पयस्वतीनामा भरेऽहं सहस्रशः॥
verses.tr: payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ vacaḥ atho payasvatīnāmā bhare'haṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.en: The plants of earth are rich in milk, and rich in milk is this my word. So from the rich in milk I bring thousandfold profit hitherward.

verses.sa:
वेदाहं पयस्वन्तं चकार धान्यं ऽ बहु।
संभृत्वा नाम यो देवस्तं वयं हवामहे योयो अयज्वनो गृहे॥
verses.tr: vedāhaṃ payasvantaṃ cakāra dhānyaṃ ' bahu saṃbhṛtvā nāma yo devastaṃ vayaṃ havāmahe yoyo ayajvano gṛhe
verses.en: Him who is rich in milk I know. Abundant hath he made our corn. The God whose name is Gatherer, him we invoke who dwelleth in his house who sacrifices not.

verses.sa:
इमा याः पञ्च प्रदिशो मानवीः पञ्च कृष्टयः ।
वृष्टे शापं नदीरिवेह स्फातिं समावहान्॥
verses.tr: imā yāḥ pañca pradiśo mānavīḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ vṛṣṭe śāpaṃ nadīriveha sphātiṃ samāvahān
verses.en: All the five regions of the heavens, all the five races of mankind,—As after rain the stream brings drift, let them bring increase hitherward.

verses.sa:
उदुत्सं शतधारं सहस्रधारमक्षितम्।
एवास्माकेदं धान्यं ऽ सहस्रधारमक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: udutsaṃ śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāramakṣitam evāsmākedaṃ dhānyaṃ ' sahasradhāramakṣitam
verses.en: Open the well with hundred streams, exhaustless, with a thousand streams, So cause this corn of ours to be exhaustless, with a thousand streams.

verses.sa:
शतहस्त समाहर सहस्रहस्त सं किर ।
कृतस्य कार्यऽस्य चेह स्फातिं समावह॥
verses.tr: śatahasta samāhara sahasrahasta saṃ kira kṛtasya kārya'sya ceha sphātiṃ samāvaha
verses.en: O Hundred-handed, gather up. O Thousand-handed, pour thou forth. Bring. hither increase of the corn prepared and yet to be prepared,

verses.sa:
तिस्रो मात्रा गन्धर्वाणां चतस्रो गृहपत्न्याः ।
तासां या स्फातिमत्तमा तया त्वाभि मृशामसि॥
verses.tr: tisro mātrā gandharvāṇāṃ catasro gṛhapatnyāḥ tāsāṃ yā sphātimattamā tayā tvābhi mṛśāmasi
verses.en: Three sheaves are the Gandharvas claim, the lady of the house hath four. We touch thee with the sheaf that is the most abundant of them all.

verses.sa:
उपोहश्च समूहश्च क्षत्तारौ ते प्रजापते ।
ताविहा वहतां स्फातिं बहुं भूमानमक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: upohaśca samūhaśca kṣattārau te prajāpate tāvihā vahatāṃ sphātiṃ bahuṃ bhūmānamakṣitam
verses.en: Adding and Gathering are thy two attendants, O Prajapati. May they bring hither increase, wealth abundant, inexhaustible.

sections.label: A man's love-charm
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 25

verses.sa:
उत्तुदस्त्वोत् तुदतु मा धृथाः शयने स्वे।
इषुः कामस्य या भीमा तया विध्यामि त्वा हृदि॥
verses.tr: uttudastvot tudatu mā dhṛthāḥ śayane sve iṣuḥ kāmasya yā bhīmā tayā vidhyāmi tvā hṛdi
verses.en: Let the Impeller goad thee on. Rest not in peace upon thy bed. Terrible is the shaft of Love: therewith I pierce thee to the heart.

verses.sa:
आधीपर्णां कामशल्यामिषुं संकल्पकुल्मलाम्।
तां सुसंनतां कृत्वा कामो विध्यतु त्वा हृदि॥
verses.tr: ādhīparṇāṃ kāmaśalyāmiṣuṃ saṃkalpakulmalām tāṃ susaṃnatāṃ kṛtvā kāmo vidhyatu tvā hṛdi
verses.en: That arrow winged with longing thought, its stem Desire, its neck Resolve, Let Kama, having truly aimed, shoot forth and pierce thee in the heart.

verses.sa:
या प्लीहानं शोषयति कामस्येषुः सुसंनता ।
प्राचीनपक्षा व्योऽषा तया विध्यामि त्वा हृदि॥
verses.tr: yā plīhānaṃ śoṣayati kāmasyeṣuḥ susaṃnatā prācīnapakṣā vyo'ṣā tayā vidhyāmi tvā hṛdi
verses.en: The shaft of Kama, pointed well, that withers and consumes the spleen, 'With hasty feathers, all aglow, therewith I pierce thee to the heart.

verses.sa:
शुचा विद्धा व्योऽषया शुष्कास्याभि सर्प मा ।
मृदुर्निमन्युः केवली प्रियवादिन्यनुव्रता॥
verses.tr: śucā viddhā vyo'ṣayā śuṣkāsyābhi sarpa mā mṛdurnimanyuḥ kevalī priyavādinyanuvratā
verses.en: Pierced through with fiercely-burning heat, steal to me with thy parching lips, Gentle and humble, all mine own, devoted, with sweet words of love.

verses.sa:
आजामि त्वाजन्या परि मातुरथो पितुः ।
यथा मम क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि॥
verses.tr: ājāmi tvājanyā pari māturatho pituḥ yathā mama kratāvaso mama cittamupāyasi
verses.en: Away from mother and from sire I drive thee hither with a whip, That thou mayst be at my command and yield to every wish of mine.

verses.sa:
व्यऽस्यै मित्रावरुणौ हृदश्चित्तान्यस्यतम्।
अथैनामक्रतुं कृत्वा ममैव कृणुतं वशे॥
verses.tr: vya'syai mitrāvaruṇau hṛdaścittānyasyatam athaināmakratuṃ kṛtvā mamaiva kṛṇutaṃ vaśe
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna, expel all thought and purpose from her heart. Deprive her of her own free-will and make her subject unto me.

sections.label: A charm to win the favour of all serpents
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 26

verses.sa:
ये३स्यां स्थ प्राच्यां दिशि हेतयो नाम देवास्तेषां वो अग्निरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3syāṃ stha prācyāṃ diśi hetayo nāma devāsteṣāṃ vo agniriṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods who dwell within this eastward region, entitled Weapons, Agni forms your arrows. Be kind and gracious unto us and bless us. To you be reverence, to you be welcome!

verses.sa:
ये३स्यां स्थ दक्षिणायां दिश्यऽ विष्यवो नाम देवास्तेषां वः काम इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3syāṃ stha dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśya' viṣyavo nāma devāsteṣāṃ vaḥ kāma iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods who dwell within this southward region, entitled Eager, Kama forms your arrows. Be kind, etc.

verses.sa:
ये३स्यां स्थ प्रतीच्यां दिशि वैराजा नाम देवास्तेषां व आप इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3syāṃ stha pratīcyāṃ diśi vairājā nāma devāsteṣāṃ va āpa iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods who dwell within this westward region, whose name is Radiant, Water forms your arrows. Be kind, etc.

verses.sa:
ये३स्यां स्थोदीच्यां दिशि प्रविध्यन्तो नाम देवास्तेषां वो वात इषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3syāṃ sthodīcyāṃ diśi pravidhyanto nāma devāsteṣāṃ vo vāta iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods who dwell within this northward region, whose name is Piercers, Vata forms your arrows. Be kind, etc.

verses.sa:
ये३ऽस्यां स्थ ध्रुवायां दिशि निलिम्पा नाम देवास्तेषां व ओषधीरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3'syāṃ stha dhruvāyāṃ diśi nilimpā nāma devāsteṣāṃ va oṣadhīriṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods whose home is in this firm-set region—Nilimpas is your name—Plants are your arrows. Be kind, eta.

verses.sa:
ये३स्यां स्थोर्ध्वायां दिश्यवस्वन्तो नाम देवास्तेषां वो बृहस्पतिरिषवः ।
ते नो मृडत ते नोऽधि ब्रूत तेभ्यो वो नमस्तेभ्यो वः स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: ye3syāṃ sthordhvāyāṃ diśyavasvanto nāma devāsteṣāṃ vo bṛhaspatiriṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no'dhi brūta tebhyo vo namastebhyo vaḥ svāhā
verses.en: Ye Gods whose home is in this upmost region, Yearners by name, Brihaspati forms your arrows. Be kind and gracious unto us and bless us. To you be reverence, to you be welcome!

sections.label: A charm consigning an enemy to the serpents for punishment
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 27

verses.sa:
प्राची दिगग्निरधिपतिरसितो रक्षितादित्याल इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: prācī digagniradhipatirasito rakṣitādityāla iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Agni is regent of the East, its warder is Asita, the Adityas are the arrows. Worship to these the regents, these the warders, and to the arrows, yea, to these be worship! Within your jaws we lay the man who hateth us and whom we hate.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणा दिगिन्द्रोऽधिपतिस्तिरश्चिराजी रक्षिता पितर इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇā digindro'dhipatistiraścirājī rakṣitā pitara iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Indra is regent of the South, its warder Tiraschiraji, and the shafts the Fathers. Worship to these the regents, these the warders, and to the arrows, yea, to these be worship! Within your jaws we lay the man who hateth us and whom we hate.

verses.sa:
प्रतीची दिग् वरुणोऽधिपतिः पृदाकू रक्षितान्नमिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: pratīcī dig varuṇo'dhipatiḥ pṛdākū rakṣitānnamiṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Of the West region Varuna is ruler, Pridaku warder, Nourishment the arrows. Worship, etc.

verses.sa:
उदीची दिक् सोमोऽधिपतिः स्वजो रक्षिताशनिरिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: udīcī dik somo'dhipatiḥ svajo rakṣitāśaniriṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Soma is ruler of the Western region, Svaja the warder, lightning's flash the arrows. Worship, etc.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा दिग् विष्णुरधिपतिः कल्माषग्रीवो रक्षिता वीरुध इषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: dhruvā dig viṣṇuradhipatiḥ kalmāṣagrīvo rakṣitā vīrudha iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Vishnu is ruler of the firm-set region, Kalmashagriva warder, Plants the arrows. Worship, etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा दिग् बृहस्पतिरधिपतिः श्वित्रो रक्षिता वर्षमिषवः ।
तेभ्यो नमोऽधिपतिभ्यो नमो रक्षितृभ्यो नम इषुभ्यो नम एभ्यो अस्तु ।
यो३स्मान् द्वेष्टि यं वयं द्विष्मस्तं वो जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvā dig bṛhaspatiradhipatiḥ śvitro rakṣitā varṣamiṣavaḥ tebhyo namo'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo nama ebhyo astu yo3smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmastaṃ vo jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Brihaspati controls the topmost region, Svitra is warder, and the Rain the arrows. Worship to these the regents, these the warders, and to the arrows, yea, to these be worship! Within your jaws we lay the man who hateth us and whom we hate.

sections.label: A charm to change the ill-omened birth of twin calves into a blessing
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 28

verses.sa:
एकैकयैषा सृष्ट्या सं बभूव यत्र गा असृजन्त भूतकृतो विश्वरूपाः ।
यत्र विजायते यमिन्यपर्तुः सा पशून् क्षिणाति रिफती रुशती॥
verses.tr: ekaikayaiṣā sṛṣṭyā saṃ babhūva yatra gā asṛjanta bhūtakṛto viśvarūpāḥ yatra vijāyate yaminyapartuḥ sā paśūn kṣiṇāti riphatī ruśatī
