verses.en: This cow was born to bring forth offspring singly, though they created kine of every colour. When she produces twins in spite of Order, sullen, with groan and grudge she harms the cattle.

verses.sa:
एषा पशून्त्सं क्षिणाति क्रव्याद् भूत्वा व्यद्वरी ।
उतैनां ब्रह्मणे दद्यात् तथा स्योना शिवा स्यात्॥
verses.tr: eṣā paśūntsaṃ kṣiṇāti kravyād bhūtvā vyadvarī utaināṃ brahmaṇe dadyāt tathā syonā śivā syāt
verses.en: She brings destruction on the beasts, turned to a flesh-devouring worm. Yea, give her to the Brahman that she may bring luck and happiness.

verses.sa:
शिवा भव पुरुषेभ्यो गोभ्यो अश्वेभ्यः शिवा।
शिवास्मै सर्वस्मै क्षेत्राय शिवा न इहैधि॥
verses.tr: śivā bhava puruṣebhyo gobhyo aśvebhyaḥ śivā śivāsmai sarvasmai kṣetrāya śivā na ihaidhi
verses.en: Be thou auspicious to our folk, bring luck to horses and to kine. Auspicious unto all this farm, bring luck and happiness to us.

verses.sa: इह पुष्टिरिह रस इह सहस्रसातमा भव । पशून् यमिनि पोषय॥
verses.tr: iha puṣṭiriha rasa iha sahasrasātamā bhava paśūn yamini poṣaya
verses.en: Let there be rain and increase here, here be thou most munificent. Mother of twins, prosper our herd.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दः सुकृतो मदन्ति विहाय रोगं तन्व१ स्वायाः ।
तं लोकं यमिन्यभिसंबभूव सा नो मा हिंसीत् पुरुषान् पशूंश्च॥
verses.tr: yatrā suhārdaḥ sukṛto madanti vihāya rogaṃ tanva1 svāyāḥ taṃ lokaṃ yaminyabhisaṃbabhūva sā no mā hiṃsīt puruṣān paśūṃśca
verses.en: Where, having left all sickness of their bodies, the pious lead, as friends, their lives of gladness—Nigh to that world approached the twin calves' mother. Let her not harm our people and our cattle.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दां सुकृतामग्निहोत्रहुतां यत्र लोकः ।
तं लोकं यमिन्यभिसंबभूव सा नो मा हिंसीत् पुरुषान् पशूंश्च॥
verses.tr: yatrā suhārdāṃ sukṛtāmagnihotrahutāṃ yatra lokaḥ taṃ lokaṃ yaminyabhisaṃbabhūva sā no mā hiṃsīt puruṣān paśūṃśca
verses.en: Where lies the world of those dear friend. the pious, those who have brought due sacrifice to Agni ni Nigh to that world approached the twins calves' mother. Let her not harm our people and our cattle.

sections.label: On the means to obtain immunity from taxation in the next world
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 29

verses.sa:
यद् राजानो विभजन्त इष्टापूर्तस्य षोडशं यमस्यामी सभासदः ।
अविस्तस्मात् प्र मुञ्चति दत्तः शितिपात् स्वधा॥
verses.tr: yad rājāno vibhajanta iṣṭāpūrtasya ṣoḍaśaṃ yamasyāmī sabhāsadaḥ avistasmāt pra muñcati dattaḥ śitipāt svadhā
verses.en: When yonder kings who sit beside Yama divide among themselves the sixteenth part of hopes fulfilled, A ram bestowed as sacrifice, white-footed, frees us from the tax.

verses.sa:
सर्वान् कामान् पूरयत्याभवन् प्रभवन् भवन्।
आकूतिप्रोऽविर्दत्तः शितिपान्नोप दस्यति॥
verses.tr: sarvān kāmān pūrayatyābhavan prabhavan bhavan ākūtipro'virdattaḥ śitipānnopa dasyati
verses.en: He satisfies each hope and want, prevailing, present and prepared. The wish-fulfilling ram, bestowed, white-footed, is exhaustless still.

verses.sa:
यो ददाति शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम्।
स नाकमभ्यारोहति यत्र शुल्को न क्रियते अबलेन बलीयसे॥
verses.tr: yo dadāti śitipādamaviṃ lokena saṃmitam sa nākamabhyārohati yatra śulko na kriyate abalena balīyase
verses.en: He who bestows a white-hooved ram, adequate to the place he holds, Ascends to the celestial height, the heaven where tribute is not paid to one more mighty by the weak.

verses.sa:
पञ्चापूपं शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम्।
प्रदातोप जीवति पितॄणां लोकेऽक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: pañcāpūpaṃ śitipādamaviṃ lokena saṃmitam pradātopa jīvati pitṝṇāṃ loke'kṣitam
verses.en: He who bestows a white-hooved ram, adequate to the place he holds, Offered with five cakes, lives on that, unwasting, in the Fathers' world.

verses.sa:
पञ्चापूपं शितिपादमविं लोकेन संमितम्।
प्रदातोप जीवति सूर्यामासयोरक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: pañcāpūpaṃ śitipādamaviṃ lokena saṃmitam pradātopa jīvati sūryāmāsayorakṣitam
verses.en: He who bestows a white-hooved ram, adequate to the place he holds, Offered with five cakes, lives on that, wasteless, while Sun and Moon endure.

verses.sa:
इरेव नोप दस्यति समुद्रइव पयो महत्।
देवउसवासिनाविव शितिपान्नोप दस्यति॥
verses.tr: ireva nopa dasyati samudraiva payo mahat devausavāsināviva śitipānnopa dasyati
verses.en: Like a refreshing draught, like sea, the mighty flood, he faileth not. Like the two Gods whose home is one, the ram white-footed, faileth not.

verses.sa:
क इदं कस्मा अदात् कामः कामायादात्।
कामो दाता कामः प्रतिग्रहीता कामः समुद्रमा विवेश ।
कामेन त्वा प्रति गृह्णामि कामैतत् ते॥
verses.tr: ka idaṃ kasmā adāt kāmaḥ kāmāyādāt kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaḥ samudramā viveśa kāmena tvā prati gṛhṇāmi kāmaitat te
verses.en: Whose gift was this, and given to whom? Kama to Kama gave the gift. Kama is giver, Kama is receiver. Kama hath passed into the sea. Through Kama do I take thee to myself. O Kama, this is thine.

verses.sa:
भूमिष्ट्वा प्रति गृह्णात्वन्तरिक्षमिदं महत्।
माहं प्राणेन मात्मना मा प्रजया प्रतिगृह्य वि राधिषि॥
verses.tr: bhūmiṣṭvā prati gṛhṇātvantarikṣamidaṃ mahat māhaṃ prāṇena mātmanā mā prajayā pratigṛhya vi rādhiṣi
verses.en: May Earth receive thee as her own, and this great interspace of air. Neither in breath and body nor in progeny may this acceptance do me harm.

sections.label: A charm to secure love and concord in a family
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 30

verses.sa:
सहृदयं सांमनस्यमविद्वेषं कृणोमि वः ।
अन्यो अन्यमभि हर्यत वत्सं जातमिवाघ्न्या॥
verses.tr: sahṛdayaṃ sāṃmanasyamavidveṣaṃ kṛṇomi vaḥ anyo anyamabhi haryata vatsaṃ jātamivāghnyā
verses.en: Freedom from hate I bring to you, concord and unanimity. Love one another as the cow loveth the calf that she hath borne.

verses.sa:
अनुव्रतः पितुः पुत्रो मात्रा भवतु संमनाः ।
जाया पत्ये मधुमतीं वाचं वदतु शन्तिवाम्॥
verses.tr: anuvrataḥ pituḥ putro mātrā bhavatu saṃmanāḥ jāyā patye madhumatīṃ vācaṃ vadatu śantivām
verses.en: One-minded with his mother let the son be loyal to his sire. Let the wife, calm and gentle, speak words sweet as honey to her lord.

verses.sa:
मा भ्राता भ्रातरं द्विक्षन्मा स्वसारमुत स्वसा ।
सम्यञ्चः सव्रता भूत्वा वाचं वदत भद्रया॥
verses.tr: mā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ dvikṣanmā svasāramuta svasā samyañcaḥ savratā bhūtvā vācaṃ vadata bhadrayā
verses.en: No brother hate his brother, no sister to sister be unkind. Unanimous, with one intent, speak ye your speech in friendliness.

verses.sa:
येन देवा न वियन्ति नो च विद्विषते मिथः ।
तत् कृण्मो ब्रह्म वो गृहे संज्ञानं पुरुषेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: yena devā na viyanti no ca vidviṣate mithaḥ tat kṛṇmo brahma vo gṛhe saṃjñānaṃ puruṣebhyaḥ
verses.en: That spell through which Gods sever not, nor ever bear each other hate, That spell we lay upon your home, a bond of union for the men.

verses.sa:
ज्यायस्वन्तश्चित्तिनो मा वि यौष्ट संराधयन्तः सधुराश्चरन्तः ।
अन्यो अन्यस्मै वल्गु वदन्त एत सध्रीचीनान् वः संमनसस्कृणोमि॥
verses.tr: jyāyasvantaścittino mā vi yauṣṭa saṃrādhayantaḥ sadhurāścarantaḥ anyo anyasmai valgu vadanta eta sadhrīcīnān vaḥ saṃmanasaskṛṇomi
verses.en: Intelligent, submissive, rest united, friendly and kind, bearing the yoke together. Come, speaking sweetly each one to the other. I make you one-intentioned and one-minded.

verses.sa:
समानी प्रपा सह वोऽन्नभागः समाने योक्त्रे सह वो युनज्मि ।
सम्यञ्चोऽग्निं सपर्यतारा नाभिमिवाभितः॥
verses.tr: samānī prapā saha vo'nnabhāgaḥ samāne yoktre saha vo yunajmi samyañco'gniṃ saparyatārā nābhimivābhitaḥ
verses.en: Let what you drink, your share of food be common: together, with one common bond I bind you. Serve Agni, gathered round him like the spokes about the chariot nave.

verses.sa:
सध्रीचीनान् वः संमनसस्कृणोम्येकश्नुष्टीन्त्संवननेन सर्वान्।
देवा इवामृतं रक्षमाणाः सायंप्रातः सौमनसो वो अस्तु॥
verses.tr: sadhrīcīnān vaḥ saṃmanasaskṛṇomyekaśnuṣṭīntsaṃvananena sarvān devā ivāmṛtaṃ rakṣamāṇāḥ sāyaṃprātaḥ saumanaso vo astu
verses.en: With binding charm I make you all united, obeying one sole leader and one-minded. Even as the Gods who watch and guard the Amrit, at morn and eve may ye be kindly-hearted.

sections.label: A charm for the recovery of one dangerously ill
sections.name: Book 3, hymn 31

verses.sa:
वि देवा जरसावृतन् वि त्वमग्ने अरात्या ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: vi devā jarasāvṛtan vi tvamagne arātyā vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: May Gods release from failing strength, thou Agni, from malignity! I free from every evil, from decline: I compass round with life.

verses.sa:
व्यार्त्या पवमानो वि शक्रः पापकृत्यया ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: vyārtyā pavamāno vi śakraḥ pāpakṛtyayā vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: May Pavamana free from harm, and Sakra from unrighteous deed. I free from every evil, from decline: I compass round with life.

verses.sa:
वि ग्राम्याः पशव आरण्यैर्व्याऽपस्तृष्णयासरन्।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: vi grāmyāḥ paśava āraṇyairvyā'pastṛṣṇayāsaran vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Tame beasts have parted from wild beasts, water and thirst have gone apart. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
वी३मे द्यावापृथिवी इतो वि पन्थानो दिशंदिशम्।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: vī3me dyāvāpṛthivī ito vi panthāno diśaṃdiśam vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Parted are heaven and earth, and paths turned to each quarter of the sky. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं युनक्तीतीदं विश्वं भुवनं वि याति ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ yunaktītīdaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi yāti vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Tvashtar prepares the bridal of his daughter; then all this world of life departs and leaves him. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्राणान्त्सं दधाति चन्द्रः प्राणेन संहितः ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: agniḥ prāṇāntsaṃ dadhāti candraḥ prāṇena saṃhitaḥ vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Agni combines the vital airs. The Moon is closely joined with breath. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणेन विश्वतोवीर्यं देवाः सूर्यं समैरयन्।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: prāṇena viśvatovīryaṃ devāḥ sūryaṃ samairayan vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: The Gods have lifted up with breath the Sun whose might is everywhere. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
आयुष्मतामायुष्कृतां प्राणेन जीव मा मृथाः ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: āyuṣmatāmāyuṣkṛtāṃ prāṇena jīva mā mṛthāḥ vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Die not. Live with the breath of those who make and who enjoy long life. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणेन प्राणतां प्राणेहैव भव मा मृथाः ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: prāṇena prāṇatāṃ prāṇehaiva bhava mā mṛthāḥ vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Die not. Stay here. Breathe with the breath of those who draw the vital air. I free, etc.

verses.sa:
उदायुषा समायुषोदोषधीनां रसेन ।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: udāyuṣā samāyuṣodoṣadhīnāṃ rasena vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: Rise up with life, conjoined with life, Up, with the sap of growing plants! I free, etc.

verses.sa:
आपर्जन्यस्य वृष्ट्योदस्थामामृता वयम्।
व्य१हं सर्वेण पाप्मना वि यक्ष्मेण समायुषा॥
verses.tr: āparjanyasya vṛṣṭyodasthāmāmṛtā vayam vya1haṃ sarveṇa pāpmanā vi yakṣmeṇa samāyuṣā
verses.en: We as immortal beings have arisen with Parjanya's rain. I free from every evil, from decline: I compass round with life.
